#Fig 1

```{r}
Mut<-read.table("~/Desktop/table.tsv",header=T,sep="\t")
Mut$Pos<-as.numeric(Mut$Pos)
Mut$Name<-paste(Mut$Original,Mut$Pos,Mut$Mutation,sep="")

Rect<-data.frame("X_S"=c(13,97,279),"X_E"=c(75,162,343),"Color"=c("#0A76B9","#10A94B","#CED0CF"),X_pos=c(44,129.5,311),"Label"=c("KH1","KH2","KH3"))

I295T<-Mut[which(Mut$Pos %in% c(295)),]
G292D<-Mut[which(Mut$Pos %in% c(292)),]
I302M<-Mut[which(Mut$Pos %in% c(302)),]
Y183<-Mut[which(Mut$Pos %in% c(183)),]


ggplot(data=Mut, aes(x=Pos, y=X))+
  geom_bar(data=Mut, aes(x=Pos, y=X),stat = "identity", size=.1, width=1, color="#010203", position="dodge")+
  geom_point(size=.6, color="orange")+
  geom_text(data=Y183,aes(x=Pos,y = X, label = Name), hjust=-0.1,vjust = 0.1, colour = "black",family="Arial",size=2.5)+
  geom_text(data=G292D,aes(x=Pos,y = X, label = Name), hjust=1.05,vjust = 0, colour = "black",family="Arial",size=2.5)+
  geom_text(data=I295T,aes(x=Pos,y = X, label = Name), hjust=1.05,vjust =0, colour = "black",family="Arial",size=2.5)+
  geom_text(data=I302M,aes(x=Pos,y = X, label = Name), hjust=0,vjust = 0, colour = "black",family="Arial",size=2.5)+
  geom_rect(inherit.aes=F,data=Rect, aes(ymin=-1.3-0.3,ymax=-0.7-0.3,xmin=0,xmax=max(Mut$Pos)),fill="black",alpha=1,size=.5)+
  geom_rect(inherit.aes=F,data=Rect, aes(ymin=-2-0.3,ymax=0-0.3,xmin=X_S,xmax=X_E,color=Color),fill="white",alpha=1,size=.5)+
  geom_text(data=Rect,aes(x=X_pos,y = -1.3, label = Label), hjust=0.5,vjust = 0.5, colour = "black",family="Arial",size=2.5)+
  scale_color_identity()+
  theme_classic()+
  #lims(y=c(-4,20))+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        axis.title=element_blank(),
        axis.text=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks=element_blank(),
        axis.line=element_blank())
ggsave("Burkitt/Mut.pdf",height = 1.5,width = 3)

```


#Fig1A-Top
```{r Fig3A-1, message=F, warning=F,echo=F,fig.width=3, fig.height=1.5}
rm(list=ls())
library("ggmsa")
Mut<-read.table("Figure 1-2 Combined /Figure2/Data/Mutation Rate/txt_file/frequent-mutations.2025-03-10.tsv",header=T,sep="\t")
Mut<-Mut[which(Mut$type=="Substitution"),]
Mut<-Mut[which(Mut$consequence %in%"Missense","Stop Gained"),]
Mut$Position<-sapply(Mut$protein_change,function(x){strsplit(x," ")[[1]][2]})
Mut$Position<-gsub(paste(LETTERS,collapse="|"),"",Mut$Position)
Mut$Position<-as.numeric(Mut$Position)

Plot_pos<-Mut %>% group_by(Position) %>% summarise(Total=sum(num_ssm_affected_cases)) %>% data.frame()

Rect<-data.frame("X_S"=c(13,97,279),"X_E"=c(75,162,343),"Color"=c("#0A76B9","#10A94B","#CED0CF"),X_pos=c(44,129.5,311),"Label"=c("KH1","KH2","KH3"))


L100<-Plot_pos[which(Plot_pos$Position %in% c(100)),]
L102<-Plot_pos[which(Plot_pos$Position %in% c(102)),]
L100$Name<-"L100P/Q/R"
L102$Name<-"L102P/Q"


ggplot(data=Plot_pos, aes(x=Position, y=Total))+
  geom_bar(data=Plot_pos, aes(x=Position, y=Total),stat = "identity", size=.1, width=1, color="#010203", position="dodge")+
  geom_point(size=.6, color="orange")+
  geom_point(inherit.aes = F,data = L100,aes(x=Position, y=Total),color=L100_col)+
  geom_point(inherit.aes = F,data = L102,aes(x=Position, y=Total),color=L102_col)+
  geom_text(data=L100,aes(x=Position,y = Total, label = Name), hjust=-0.1,vjust = 0, colour = "black",family="Arial",size=2.5)+
  geom_text(data=L102,aes(x=Position,y = Total, label = Name), hjust=-0.1,vjust = 0, colour = "black",family="Arial",size=2.5)+
  geom_rect(inherit.aes=F,data=Rect, aes(ymin=-1.3-0.3,ymax=-0.7-0.3,xmin=0,xmax=max(Mut$Position)),fill="black",alpha=1,size=.5)+
  geom_rect(inherit.aes=F,data=Rect, aes(ymin=-2-0.3,ymax=0-0.3,xmin=X_S,xmax=X_E,color=Color),fill="white",alpha=1,size=.5)+
  geom_text(data=Rect,aes(x=X_pos,y = -1.3, label = Label), hjust=0.5,vjust = 0.5, colour = "black",family="Arial",size=2.5)+
  scale_color_identity()+
  theme_classic()+
  lims(y=c(-4,20))+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        axis.title=element_blank(),
        axis.text=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks=element_blank(),
        axis.line=element_blank())
ggsave("Figure 1-2 Combined /ATop.pdf",height = 1.5,width = 3)

```


```{r,fig.width=2,fig.height=2}
rm(list=ls())
library(ComplexUpset)
library(tidyverse)
library(UpSetR)

pcbp1<-read.table("PCBP1_muts.tsv",sep="\t",skip=1)
pcbp1<-pcbp1[which(pcbp1$V5 %in% c("L100P","L100Q","L102P","L102Q","L102R")),]

apc<-read.table("APC_muts.tsv",sep="\t",skip=1)
kras<-read.table("KRAS_muts.tsv",sep="\t",skip=1)
tp53<-read.table("TP53_muts.tsv",sep="\t",skip=1)

apc<-apc[which(apc$V2 %in% pcbp1$V2),]
kras<-kras[which(kras$V2 %in% pcbp1$V2),]
tp53<-tp53[which(tp53$V2 %in% pcbp1$V2),]

all <- bind_rows(
  tibble(sample = pcbp1$V2, gene = "PCBP1"),
  tibble(sample = apc$V2,   gene = "APC"),
  tibble(sample = kras$V2,  gene = "KRAS"),
  tibble(sample = tp53$V2,  gene = "TP53")
)

df <- all %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(mutations = list(sort(unique(gene))), .groups = "drop") %>% distinct()

df

library(ggupset)
p<-ggplot(df, aes(x = mutations)) +
  geom_bar(width=.7,fill="#B04E52") +
  ggupset::scale_x_upset(order_by = "freq") +
  labs(y = "Number of samples")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=10, color="black"),
        axis.title=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(1, "pt"),
        ggupset.axis.text = element_text(color = "steelblue"),
        ggupset.axis.ticks = element_line(color = "steelblue"),
        ggupset.matrix.line = element_line(color = "steelblue"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5))
p
ggsave("Figure 1-2 Combined/Mut_overlap.pdf",p,height = 1.75,width = 2)
```

#Fig 1-Pie
```{r,fig.width=1.3,fig.height=1.3}
Mut<-read.table("Figure 1-2 Combined /Figure2/Data/Mutation Rate/txt_file/frequent-mutations.2025-03-10.tsv",header=T,sep="\t")
Mut<-Mut[grepl("L100",Mut$protein_change),]
Mut<-Mut[c("protein_change","num_gdc_ssm_affected_cases")]
Mut$protein_change<-gsub("PCBP1 L100","",Mut$protein_change)
Mut$fraction = Mut$num_gdc_ssm_affected_cases / sum(Mut$num_gdc_ssm_affected_cases)
Mut$ymax = cumsum(Mut$fraction)
Mut$ymin = c(0, head(Mut$ymax, n = -1))
Mut$label_position = (Mut$ymax + Mut$ymin) / 2  # For text positioning
Mut$Label<-paste(Mut$protein_change,"=",Mut$num_gdc_ssm_affected_cases,sep="")
my_colors<-c("P"="#DC9682","Q"=L100_col,"R"="#145AFF")
ggplot(Mut, aes(ymax = ymax, ymin = ymin, xmax = 1, xmin = 0, fill = protein_change)) +
  geom_rect() +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) + 
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.4, y = label_position, label = Label), size = 4,family="Arial") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave("Figure 1-2 Combined /Fig1_pie1.pdf",width=1.5,height=1.5)
```

```{r,fig.width=1.3,fig.height=1.3}
Mut<-read.delim("Figure 1-2 Combined /Figure2/Data/Mutation Rate/txt_file/PCBP1_mutation_other_studies.tsv")
```

#Fig1B
```{r,fig.width=1.75, fig.height=1}
rm(list=ls())
r_sec<-read.table("Figure 1-2 Combined /Figure 1/Data/SEC recombinant/txt_data/recombinantSEC_R.txt",header=T,sep="\t")

#Mean
r_sec$WT_Mean<-apply(r_sec[c("WT1","WT2","WT3")],1,mean,na.rm=T)
r_sec$L100Q_Mean<-apply(r_sec[c("MUT1","MUT2","MUT3")],1,mean,na.rm=T)

#sd
r_sec$WT_sd<-apply(r_sec[c("WT1","WT2","WT3")],1,sd,na.rm=T)
r_sec$L100Q_sd<-apply(r_sec[c("MUT1","MUT2","MUT3")],1,sd,na.rm=T)

#se
r_sec$WT_se<-r_sec$WT_sd/sqrt(3)
r_sec$L100Q_se<-r_sec$L100Q_sd/sqrt(3)


#test
r_sec$P_val<-NA
for (i in 1:nrow(r_sec)){
  test<-t.test(r_sec[i,c("WT1","WT2","WT3")],r_sec[i,c("MUT1","MUT2","MUT3")])
  r_sec$P_val[i]<-test$p.value
}
r_sec$FDR<-p.adjust(r_sec$P_val,method = "fdr")

r_sec<-r_sec %>% mutate(Label=case_when(
  FDR<0.0001~"****",
  FDR<0.001~"***",
  FDR<0.01~"**",
  FDR<0.05~"*"
))


r_sec$wt_ymax<-r_sec$WT_Mean+r_sec$WT_se
r_sec$mut_ymax<-r_sec$L100Q_Mean+r_sec$L100Q_se

r_sec$Ypos<-apply(r_sec[c("wt_ymax","mut_ymax")],1,max)
r_sec$Fraction<-factor(r_sec$Fraction)

wt<-r_sec[c("Fraction","WT_Mean","WT_sd","WT_se")]
mut<-r_sec[c("Fraction","L100Q_Mean","L100Q_sd","L100Q_se")]

colnames(wt)<-c("Fraction","Mean","SD","SE")
colnames(mut)<-c("Fraction","Mean","SD","SE")

wt$Group<-"WT"
mut$Group<-"L100Q"

df<-data.frame(rbind(wt,mut))
df$Group<-factor(df$Group,levels=c("WT","L100Q"))
df$Fraction<-factor(df$Fraction)

ggplot()+
  geom_line(data=df,aes(x=Fraction,y=Mean,group = Group,color=Group),size=.25)+
  geom_point(data=df,aes(x=Fraction,y=Mean),color="black",size=0.3)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("WT"=Parent_col, "L100Q"=L100_col))+
  geom_errorbar(data=df,aes(x=Fraction,ymin=Mean-SE, ymax=Mean+SE), color="black",width=0.3,size=0.2)+
  theme_classic()+
  lims(y=c(0,1))+
  xlab("Fraction")+
  ylab("Rel. Signal")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = c(0.2,0.85),
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"))
ggsave("Figure 1-2 Combined /Fig1B.pdf",height = 1,width = 1.75)
```

```{r,fig.width=1.75, fig.height=1}
))

endo<-r_sec[c("Fraction","Endo_Mean","Endo_sd","Endo_se")]

colnames(wt)<-c("Fraction","Mean","SD","SE")
colnames(mut)<-c("Fraction","Mean","SD","SE")
colnames(endo)<-c("Fraction","Mean","SD","SE")

mut$Group<-"FLAG L100Q"
```

#Fig1E
```{r,fig.width=2, fig.height=1}
rm(list=ls())
vol<-read.table("Figure 1-2 Combined /Figure 1/Data/MP/txt_data/MP_R.txt",header=T,sep="\t")
vol_long<-reshape2::melt(vol)
vol_long$Group<-cut(vol_long$value,breaks = seq(0,300,10),labels=seq(0,300,10)[-1])
vol_tab<-data.frame(table(vol_long$variable,vol_long$Group))
vol_wide<-reshape(vol_tab, idvar = "Var2", timevar = "Var1", direction = "wide")
colnames(vol_wide)<-gsub("Freq.","",colnames(vol_wide))
vol_wide[,2:9]<-sweep(vol_wide[,2:9],2,colSums(vol_wide[,2:9]),"/")

vol_wide$WT_mean<-apply(vol_wide[c("MP1_WT","MP2_WT","MP3_WT","MP4_WT")],1,mean,na.rm=T)
vol_wide$L100Q_mean<-apply(vol_wide[c("MP1_MUT","MP2_MUT","MP3_MUT","MP4_MUT")],1,mean,na.rm=T)

vol_wide$WT_sd<-apply(vol_wide[c("MP1_WT","MP2_WT","MP3_WT","MP4_WT")],1,sd,na.rm=T)
vol_wide$L100Q_sd<-apply(vol_wide[c("MP1_MUT","MP2_MUT","MP3_MUT","MP4_MUT")],1,sd,na.rm=T)

wt<-vol_wide[c("Var2","WT_mean","WT_sd")]
mut<-vol_wide[c("Var2","L100Q_mean","L100Q_sd")]
colnames(wt)<-c("Var2","Mean","SD")
colnames(mut)<-c("Var2","Mean","SD")

wt$SE<-wt$SD/sqrt(4)
mut$SE<-mut$SD/sqrt(4)

wt$Group<-"WT"
mut$Group<-"L100Q"

df<-data.frame(rbind(wt,mut))
df$Group<-factor(df$Group,levels=c("WT","L100Q"))
df$Var2<-as.numeric(as.character(df$Var2))

test<-ks.test(wt$Mean,mut$Mean)
p<-round(test$p.value,3)

ggplot()+
  geom_line(data=df,aes(x=Var2,y=Mean,group = Group,color=Group),size=.25)+
  geom_point(data=df,aes(x=Var2,y=Mean),color="black",size=0.3)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("WT"=Parent_col, "L100Q"=L100_col))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_errorbar(data=df,aes(x=Var2,ymin=Mean-SE, ymax=Mean+SE), color="black",width=8,size=0.3)+#standard error
  annotate("text", x = 260, y = 0.05, label = bquote(italic(P)==.(p)), color = "black", size = 2, family = "Arial") + 
  xlab("Mass (kDa)")+
  ylab("Fraction of \n Single Molecules")+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0,50,100,150,200,250,300))+
  theme(legend.position = c(0.85,0.9),
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"))
ggsave("Figure 1-2 Combined /Fig1E.pdf",width=2,height = 1)
```

```{r,fig.width=1.6, fig.height=0.8}
rm(list=ls())
df<-read.table("Figure 1-2 Combined /Figure2/Data/Delta Phe SEC/txt_data/Blank.txt",header = T)
df$Pos<-rownames(df)
df2<-read.table("Figure 1-2 Combined /Figure2/Data/Delta KH2 SEC/txt_data/delKH2.txt",header = T)

df$WT_mean<-apply(df[c("WT2_Del_Phe","WT1_Del_Phe","WT3_Del_Phe")],1,mean,na.rm=T)
df$L100Q_mean<-apply(df[c("MUT2_Del_Phe","MUT1_Del_Phe","MUT3_Del_Phe")],1,mean,na.rm=T)

df$WT_sd<-apply(df[c("WT2_Del_Phe","WT1_Del_Phe","WT3_Del_Phe")],1,sd,na.rm=T)
df$L100Q_sd<-apply(df[c("MUT2_Del_Phe","MUT1_Del_Phe","MUT3_Del_Phe")],1,sd,na.rm=T)

df2$Mean<-apply(df2[c(2:4)],1,mean,na.rm=T)
df2$sd<-apply(df2[c(2:4)],1,sd,na.rm=T)

#se
df$WT_se<-df$WT_sd/sqrt(3)
df$L100Q_se<-df$L100Q_sd/sqrt(3)
df2$se<-df2$sd/sqrt(3)

#test
p_vals_L100<-c()
p_vals_kh2<-c()
for (i in 1:nrow(df)){
  test<-t.test(df[i,c("WT1_Del_Phe","WT2_Del_Phe","WT3_Del_Phe")],df[i,c("MUT1_Del_Phe","MUT2_Del_Phe","MUT3_Del_Phe")])
  test2<-t.test(df[i,c("WT1_Del_Phe","WT2_Del_Phe","WT3_Del_Phe")],df2[i,c("DelKH2_1","DelKH2_2","DelKH2_3")])
  p_vals_L100$P_val[i]<-test$p.value
  p_vals_kh2$P_val[i]<-test2$p.value
}
pval_df<-data.frame("Fraction"=df$Fraction,"L100"=p_vals_L100$P_val,"KH2"=p_vals_kh2$P_val)
pval_df$L100_FDR<-p.adjust(pval_df$L100,method = "fdr")
pval_df$KH2_FDR<-p.adjust(pval_df$KH2,method = "fdr")

pval_df<-pval_df %>% mutate(L100_Label=case_when(
  L100_FDR<0.0001~"****",
  L100_FDR<0.001~"***",
  L100_FDR<0.01~"**",
  L100_FDR<0.05~"*"
))

pval_df<-pval_df %>% mutate(KH2_Label=case_when(
  KH2_FDR<0.0001~"****",
  KH2_FDR<0.001~"***",
  KH2_FDR<0.01~"**",
  KH2_FDR<0.05~"*"
))
pval_df$Fraction<-factor(pval_df$Fraction)
pval_df$L100_mean<-df$L100Q_mean
pval_df$KH2_mean<-df2$Mean

wt<-df[c("Fraction","WT_mean","WT_se")]
mut<-df[c("Fraction","L100Q_mean","L100Q_se")]
kh<-df2[c("Fraction","Mean","se")]

colnames(wt)<-c("Fraction","Mean","SE")
colnames(mut)<-c("Fraction","Mean","SE")
colnames(kh)<-c("Fraction","Mean","SE")

wt$Group<-"WT"
mut$Group<-"L100Q"
kh$Group<-"KH2"

comb<-data.frame(rbind(wt,mut,kh))
comb$Fraction<-factor(comb$Fraction)

ggplot()+
  geom_line(data=comb,aes(x=Fraction,y=Mean,group = Group,color=Group),size=0.25)+
  geom_point(data=comb,aes(x=Fraction,y=Mean),color="black",size=0.3)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("WT"=Parent_col, "L100Q"=L100_col,"KH2"="#EFD127"),
                     labels=c("WT"=bquote(WT^"F->A"),"L100Q"=bquote(L100Q^"F->A"),"KH2"=bquote(WT~Delta~KH2)))+
  theme_classic()+
  lims(y=c(0,0.8))+
  geom_errorbar(data=comb,aes(x=Fraction,ymin=Mean-SE, ymax=Mean+SE), color="black",width=0.3,size=0.2)+#standard error
  geom_text(inherit.aes = F,data = pval_df,aes(x=Fraction,y=L100_mean,label=L100_Label),size=3,vjust=-0.35,color=L100_col)+
  geom_text(inherit.aes = F,data = pval_df,aes(x=Fraction,y=KH2_mean,label=KH2_Label),size=3,vjust=-0.05,color="#EFD127")+
  xlab("Fraction")+
  ylab("Rel. Signal")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = c(0.2,0.75),
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"))
ggsave("Figure 1-2 Combined /Fig1I.pdf",height = 1.2,width = 2)
```

```{r,fig.width=1.5, fig.height=1.5}
Cs

mt$protein <- sapply(as.character(mt$variable), function(x) strsplit(x, "_")[[1]][1])
mt$conc <- sapply(as.character(mt$variable), function(x) strsplit(x, "_")[[1]][3])
mt$rep <- sapply(as.character(mt$variable), function(x) strsplit(x, "_")[[1]][2])
mt$conc=factor(mt$conc, levels = c(10, 50, 200))
mt$protein=factor(mt$protein, levels = c("WT", "L100Q"))


sub_mt<-subset(mt, mt$kmer %in% Cs)
test <- compare_means(value ~ protein, group.by = "conc",comparisons = c("WT","L100Q"), p.adjust.method = "fdr", method='wilcox.test', data = sub_mt)
```

```{r,fig.width=1.2, fig.height=1.4}
  scale_color_manual(values=c("L100Q"=L100_col, "WT"=Parent_col))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("L100Q"=L100_col, "WT"=Parent_col))+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scientific)+
  theme_classic()+
  lims(y=c(0,8e+01))+
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(color="black",size=6,family="Arial"), 
    axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
    axis.title.y = element_text(color ="black", size=6,family="Arial"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_blank() )+
  xlab("")+
  ylab(expression(paste("k"[d], ("s")^-1)))+
```

```{r,fig.width=1.2, fig.height=1.4}
rm(list=ls())

Mut<-read.table("Figure_Tables/Mut_profile.txt",header=T)
muts_df<-Mut %>% group_by(Sample) %>% dplyr::summarise(Total = sum(Freq)) %>% data.frame()
df<-merge(Mut,muts_df,by="Sample")
df$Sample<-gsub("Aligned.sorted.bam","",df$Sample)
df_new<-df[grepl("C|D|E",df$Sample),]

#grouping
C<-df_new[grepl("C",df_new$Sample),]
Rest<-df_new[grepl("D|E",df_new$Sample),]

C$stack_seq[which(!(C$stack_seq %in% c("GTC","GTT")))]<-"Other"
Rest$stack_seq[which(!(Rest$stack_seq %in% c("CAG","CTG")))]<-"Other"


C<-C %>% dplyr::group_by(Sample,stack_seq) %>% dplyr::summarise(Type=sum(Freq)) %>% data.frame()
Rest<-Rest %>% dplyr::group_by(Sample,stack_seq) %>% dplyr::summarise(Type=sum(Freq)) %>% data.frame()

C$Group<-"C"
Rest$Group<-c(rep("D",9),rep("E",9))

C<-C %>% dplyr::group_by(Group,stack_seq) %>% dplyr::summarise(Sum_Freq=sum(Type)) %>% data.frame()
Rest<-Rest %>% dplyr::group_by(Group,stack_seq) %>% dplyr::summarise(Sum_Freq=sum(Type)) %>% data.frame()

C$Class<-c("WT","L100Q","Other")
Rest$Class<-c("L100Q","WT","Other","L100Q","WT","Other")

df<-rbind(C,Rest)
df$Class<-factor(df$Class,levels=c("Other","L100Q","WT"))

ggplot(df, aes(x=Group, y=Sum_Freq, fill=Class)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black",width=0.5,alpha=0.9,position="fill",size=.2) +

        plot.background = element_blank(),
```

#Fig 2F-Insert3
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
load("Figure_Tables/HCT_new_RSEM.RData")
WT<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/IDR/GG83_GG84_reprod_Meta.bed",sep = "\t")
L100Q<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/IDR/GG87_GG88_reprod_Meta.bed",sep = "\t")
L100Q2<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/IDR/GG93_GG94_reprod_Meta.bed",sep = "\t")
HDR<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/IDR/GG91_GG92_reprod_Meta.bed",sep = "\t")
universe<-HCT$L100Q_vs_WT_DESEQ$Genes

WT_genes<-unique(strsplit(paste(WT$V5,collapse=","),",")[[1]])
L100Q_genes<-unique(strsplit(paste(L100Q$V5,collapse=","),",")[[1]])
L100Q2_genes<-unique(strsplit(paste(L100Q2$V5,collapse=","),",")[[1]])
HDR_genes<-unique(strsplit(paste(HDR$V5,collapse=","),",")[[1]])

genes<-list("Parent"=WT_genes,"L100Q-1"=L100Q_genes,"L100Q-2"=L100Q2_genes,"Silent"=HDR_genes)
ov<-c()
p_val<-c()
g1<-c()
g2<-c()
g1_count<-c()
g2_count<-c()
for (i in names(genes)){
  for (j in names(genes)){
    O<-length(intersect(genes[[i]],genes[[j]]))
    ov<-c(ov,O)
    test<-phyper(O-1,length(genes[[i]]),length(universe)-length(genes[[i]]),length(genes[[j]]),lower.tail=F)
    p_val<-c(p_val,test)
    g1<-c(g1,i)
    g2<-c(g2,j)
    g1_count<-c(g1_count,length(genes[[i]]))
    g2_count<-c(g2_count,length(genes[[j]]))
  }
}

df<-data.frame(g1,g2,ov,p_val,g1_count,g2_count)
df$padj<-p.adjust(df$p_val,method="fdr")
df$Prop1<-df$ov/df$g1_count
df$Prop2<-df$ov/df$g2_count
df$Prop<-apply(df[c("Prop1","Prop2")],1,max)

upper_mat <- df %>%
  filter(as.numeric(as.factor(g1)) < as.numeric(as.factor(g2)))


upper_mat<-upper_mat %>% mutate(Label=case_when(
  padj<0.0001~"****",
  padj<0.001~"***",
  padj<0.01~"**",
  padj<0.05~"*"
))

upper_mat$g1<-factor(upper_mat$g1,levels=c("Parent","L100Q-2","L100Q-1"))
upper_mat$g2<-factor(upper_mat$g2,levels=c("Silent","Parent","L100Q-2"))
#the 0 pvals are getting subs for 2.2e-16 ##
p1=ggplot(upper_mat, aes(x = g1, y = g2, fill =Prop)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label =round(Prop,digits=2)), size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white",high="#9D5C63",limits = c(0, 1))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_x_discrete(position = "bottom")+
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right")+
  theme(legend.position = c(0.08,0.75),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(-0.15, "cm"),
        axis.title=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_text(family="Arial",size=8, color="black"),
        axis.text.x=element_text(family="Arial",size=8, color="black",angle=45,hjust=1),
        legend.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 5),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank())
p1
ggsave("Figure3/Genes_ov_heat.pdf",width=1.5,height=1.5)
```

```{r}
rm(list=ls())

WT<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/IDR/GG83_GG84_reprod_Meta.bed",sep = "\t")
L100Q<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/IDR/GG87_GG88_reprod_Meta.bed",sep = "\t")
L100Q2<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/IDR/GG93_GG94_reprod_Meta.bed",sep = "\t")
HDR<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/IDR/GG91_GG92_reprod_Meta.bed",sep = "\t")

WT_total<-33468
L100Q_total<-45728
L100Q2_total<-34326
HDR_total<-25987

universe<-list("WT"=33468,"L100Q-1"=45728,"L100Q-2"=34326,"Silent"=25987)

WT_genes<-makeGRangesFromDataFrame(WT,start.field = "V2",end.field = "V3",seqnames.field = "V1",strand.field = "V6") %>% reduce()
L100Q_genes<-makeGRangesFromDataFrame(L100Q,start.field = "V2",end.field = "V3",seqnames.field = "V1",strand.field = "V6") %>% reduce()
L100Q2_genes<-makeGRangesFromDataFrame(L100Q2,start.field = "V2",end.field = "V3",seqnames.field = "V1",strand.field = "V6") %>% reduce()
HDR_genes<-makeGRangesFromDataFrame(HDR,start.field = "V2",end.field = "V3",seqnames.field = "V1",strand.field = "V6") %>% reduce()

genes<-list("Parent"=WT_genes,"L100Q-1"=L100Q_genes,"L100Q-2"=L100Q2_genes,"Silent"=HDR_genes)
ov<-c()
p_val<-c()
g1<-c()
g2<-c()
g1_count<-c()
g2_count<-c()
for (i in names(genes)){
  for (j in names(genes)){
    int<-findOverlaps(genes[[i]],genes[[j]])
    O<-length(reduce(c(genes[[i]][queryHits(int)],genes[[j]][subjectHits(int)])))
    ov<-c(ov,O)
    uni<-mean(c(universe[[i]],universe[[j]]))
    test<-phyper(O-1,length(genes[[i]]),uni-length(genes[[i]]),length(genes[[j]]),lower.tail=F)
    p_val<-c(p_val,test)
    g1<-c(g1,i)
    g2<-c(g2,j)
    g1_count<-c(g1_count,length(genes[[i]]))
    g2_count<-c(g2_count,length(genes[[j]]))
  }
}

df<-data.frame(g1,g2,ov,p_val,g1_count,g2_count)
df$padj<-p.adjust(df$p_val,method="fdr")
df$Prop1<-df$ov/df$g1_count
df$Prop2<-df$ov/df$g2_count
df$Prop<-apply(df[c("Prop1","Prop2")],1,max)

upper_mat <- df %>%
  filter(as.numeric(as.factor(g1)) < as.numeric(as.factor(g2)))


upper_mat<-upper_mat %>% mutate(Label=case_when(
  padj<0.0001~"****",
  padj<0.001~"***",
  padj<0.01~"**",
  padj<0.05~"*"
))

upper_mat$g1<-factor(upper_mat$g1,levels=c("Parent","L100Q-2","L100Q-1"))
upper_mat$g2<-factor(upper_mat$g2,levels=c("Silent","Parent","L100Q-2"))
#the 0 pvals are getting subs for 2.2e-16 ##

  geom_tile(color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label =round(Prop,digits=2)), size = 2.5, color = "black") +
```

```{r,fig.width=2, fig.height=1.5}
df$Group<-factor(df$Group,levels=c("Parent","Silent","L100Q-1","L100Q-2"))
ggplot(df,aes(x = Val,color=Group))+
  geom_density()+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Parent" =Parent_col, "L100Q-1" =L100_col,"Silent"=HDR_col,"L100Q-2"=L100_col2))+
  #annotate("text", x = 250, y = 0.001, label = bquote(italic(P)<2.2e-16), color = "black", size = 2, family = "Arial") + 
  theme_classic()+
  labs(x="Peak Width (bp)",y="density")+
  theme(legend.position = c(.85,.85),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(-0.15, "cm"),
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank())

ggsave("Figure3/Fig3I-2.pdf",width=1.8,height=1.5)

peaks<-list("Parent"=WT,"L100Q-1"=L100Q,"L100Q-2"=L100Q2,"Silent"=HDR)
#Pvalues
gg1<-c()
gg2<-c()
p<-c()
for (i in names(peaks)){
  for (j in names(peaks)){
    test<-ks.test(peaks[[i]]$Width,peaks[[j]]$Width,exact=T)
    gg1<-c(gg1,i)
    gg2<-c(gg2,j)
    p<-c(p,test$p.value)
  }
}
dd<-data.frame(gg1,gg2,p)
dd$padj=p.adjust(dd$p, method = "fdr")
dd

upper_mat <- dd %>%
  filter(as.numeric(as.factor(gg1)) < as.numeric(as.factor(gg2)))
upper_mat<-upper_mat %>% mutate(Label=case_when(
  padj<0.0001~"****",
  padj<0.001~"***",
  padj<0.01~"**",
  padj<0.05~"*"
))

upper_mat$padj[which(upper_mat$padj<2.2e-16)]<-2.2e-16
upper_mat$gg1<-factor(upper_mat$gg1,levels=c("Silent","L100Q-2","L100Q-1"))
upper_mat$gg2<-factor(upper_mat$gg2,levels=c("WT","Silent","L100Q-2"))
#the 0 pvals are getting subs for 2.2e-16 ##
p1=ggplot(upper_mat, aes(x = gg1, y = gg2, fill =padj)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label =Label), size = 3, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#9D5C63",high="white",limits = c(2.2e-16, max(upper_mat$padj)))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_x_discrete(position = "bottom")+
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right")+
  theme(legend.position = c(0.08,0.75),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(-0.15, "cm"),
        axis.title=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_text(family="Arial",size=8, color="black"),
        axis.text.x=element_text(family="Arial",size=8, color="black",angle=45,hjust=1),
        legend.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 5),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank())
p1
ggsave("Figure3/Fig3I-2-Legend.pdf",width=1.5,height=1.5)
```

```{r,fig.width=1.8, fig.height=1.5}
L100Q_gr<-makeGRangesFromDataFrame(L100Q,seqnames.field="V1",start.field="V2",end.field="V3",strand.field="V6")
L100Q2_gr<-makeGRangesFromDataFrame(L100Q2,seqnames.field="V1",start.field="V2",end.field="V3",strand.field="V6")

#Get Seq

seqlevelsStyle(bs) <- "UCSC"

L100Q2_seqs<-getSeq(bs,L100Q2_gr) %>% data.frame()

L100Q2_seqs$C_count<-str_count(L100Q2_seqs$.,'C')

WT_seqs$All_count<-nchar(WT_seqs$.)
L100Q_seqs$All_count<-nchar(L100Q_seqs$.)
HDR_seqs$All_count<-nchar(HDR_seqs$.)
L100Q2_seqs$All_count<-nchar(L100Q2_seqs$.)

WT_seqs$Prop<-WT_seqs$C_count/WT_seqs$All_count
L100Q_seqs$Prop<-L100Q_seqs$C_count/L100Q_seqs$All_count
HDR_seqs$Prop<-HDR_seqs$C_count/HDR_seqs$All_count
L100Q2_seqs$Prop<-L100Q2_seqs$C_count/L100Q2_seqs$All_count
```

#Fig 2L

```{r,fig.width=1.5, fig.height=1.5}
rm(list=ls())
load("Figure_Tables/RIP.RData")

L100_sig<-L100[which(L100$gene_type=="up"),]
WT_sig<-WT[which(WT$gene_type=="up"),]

#Taking events that are bound in both
all_sig<-intersect(L100_sig$Genes,WT_sig$Genes)
df<-merge(L100[c("Genes","log2FoldChange")],WT[c("Genes","log2FoldChange")],by="Genes")
df<-df[which(df$Genes %in% all_sig),]
colnames(df)<-c("Genes","Mut","Wt")
df$Col<-Parent_col
df$Col[which(df$Mut>df$Wt)]<-L100_col

Up<-paste("L100Q>WT\n",as.character(length(which(df$Mut>df$Wt))),sep="")
Down<-paste("WT>L100Q\n",as.character(length(which(df$Wt>df$Mut))),sep="")

ggplot(df,aes(x = Wt,y = Mut,color=Col,fill = Col))+
  geom_point(shape = 21,alpha=0.5)+
  scale_fill_identity()+
  scale_colour_identity()+
  labs(x="L2FC (WT / GFP)",y="L2FC (Mut / GFP)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0,linetype = "dashed")+
  annotate("text", x = 7.5, y = 2.5,label = Down, color = "black", size = 1.5, family = "Arial") + 
  annotate("text", x = 2.5, y = 7.5,label = Up, color = "black", size = 1.5, family = "Arial") + 
  lims(x=c(0,10),y=c(0,10))+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),

        legend.background = element_blank())
```

```{r,fig.width=3, fig.height=2}
L100Q_eclip<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/IDR/GG87_GG88_reprod_Meta.bed",sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
L100<-L100[which(L100$gene_type=="up"),]
```

#Fig 3A
```{r,fig.width=1.25, fig.height=1.5}
rm(list=ls())
df<-read.csv("Figure3/Data/HEK Localization/txt_data/Book16.csv",header=T)[,1:6]

means<-data.frame(colMeans(df,na.rm = T))
means$Group<-"WT"
means$Group[which(rownames(means) %in% c("L100Q1","L100Q2","L100Q3"))]<-"L100Q"
colnames(means)<-c("Mean","Group")

df_melt<-melt(df)
df_melt$Group<-"WT"
df_melt$Group[which(df_melt$variable %in% c("L100Q1","L100Q2","L100Q3"))]<-"L100Q"
df_melt$Group<-factor(df_melt$Group,levels=c("WT","L100Q"))

ggplot(df_melt,aes(x=Group,y=value,fill=Group))+
  geom_violin(alpha=0.5)+
  geom_boxplot(inherit.aes = F,data=means,aes(x=Group,y=Mean,fill=Group))+
  geom_jitter(inherit.aes = F,data=means,aes(x=Group,y=Mean,fill=Group,color=Group),position=position_jitter(0.2),size=.8)+
  theme_classic()+
  lims(y=c(0,2.6))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("L100Q"=L100_col,"WT"=Parent_col))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("L100Q"=L100_col,"WT"=Parent_col))+
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("L100Q","WT")), label.y = c(2.3),label="p.signif",method = "wilcox.test")+
  labs(x="",y="Fluorescence \n (Nuclear / Cytoplasm)")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.title=element_blank(),
        legend.key.width= unit(0.4, 'cm'),
        legend.key.height= unit(0.4, 'cm'))

ggsave("Figure4/Fig4C.pdf",height = 1.5,width = 1.25)
```

#3C-1
```{r Fig3A-1, message=F, warning=F,echo=F,fig.width=1.5, fig.height=1.5}
rm(list=ls())
files<-list.files("Figure3/Data/FRAP/txt_data/")
frap<-list()
for(m in files){
  frap[[m]]<-read.table(paste("Figure3/Data/FRAP/txt_data/",m,sep=""),header=T,sep="\t")[c("Mean_Time_ms","Mean_Signal")]
  colnames(frap[[m]])<-paste(strsplit(m,".txt")[[1]][1],colnames(frap[[m]]),sep="_")
}

frap_df<-bind_cols(frap)

#Nuclear
nuc<-frap_df[,colnames(frap_df)[grepl("QN|WN",colnames(frap_df))]]
```

#3D
```{r Fig3A-1, message=F, warning=F,echo=F,fig.width=1.8, fig.height=1.5}
rm(list=ls())
prot<-read.csv("../Omics-data/MS-IP/20250216_DominguezLab_IP_Imputed_Enrichment_Dataframe.csv",header=T)
prot<-prot[c("PG.Genes",colnames(prot)[grepl("Pvalue|log2FC|Mean|Count",colnames(prot))])]
prot<-prot[which(prot$PG.Genes !=""),]

#Filtering for spectral counts
prot$GFP_mean_counts<-rowMeans(prot[,grep("GFP_0",colnames(prot))],na.rm=T)
prot$GFP_noRNA_mean_counts<-rowMeans(prot[,grep("GFP_noRNA",colnames(prot))],na.rm=T)
prot$WT_mean_counts<-rowMeans(prot[,grep("732_0",colnames(prot))],na.rm=T)
prot$WT_noRNA_mean_counts<-rowMeans(prot[,grep("732_noRNA",colnames(prot))],na.rm=T)
prot$L100Q_mean_counts<-rowMeans(prot[,grep("733_0",colnames(prot))],na.rm=T)
prot$L100Q_noRNA_mean_counts<-rowMeans(prot[,grep("733_noRNA",colnames(prot))],na.rm=T)

#WT
wt_rna<-prot[,c("PG.Genes","WT_mean_counts","log2FC.732vsGFP","Pvalue.732vGFP")]
wt_rna<-wt_rna[which(wt_rna$WT_mean_counts>5),]

wt_no_rna<-prot[,c("PG.Genes","WT_noRNA_mean_counts","log2FC.732noRNAvsGFPnoRNA","Pvalue.732noRNAvGFPnoRNA")]
wt_no_rna<-wt_no_rna[which(wt_no_rna$WT_noRNA_mean_counts>5),]

wt_rna<-wt_rna[which(wt_rna$log2FC.732vsGFP>1 & wt_rna$Pvalue.732vGFP<0.05),]
wt_no_rna<-wt_no_rna[which(wt_no_rna$log2FC.732noRNAvsGFPnoRNA>1 & wt_no_rna$Pvalue.732noRNAvGFPnoRNA<0.05),]

wt_rna<-wt_rna[!duplicated(wt_rna$PG.Genes),]
wt_no_rna<-wt_no_rna[!duplicated(wt_no_rna$PG.Genes),]

#L100Q
l100Q_rna<-prot[,c("PG.Genes","L100Q_mean_counts","log2FC.733vsGFP","Pvalue.733vGFP")]
l100Q_rna<-l100Q_rna[which(l100Q_rna$L100Q_mean_counts>5),]

l100Q_no_rna<-prot[,c("PG.Genes","L100Q_noRNA_mean_counts","log2FC.733noRNAvsGFPnoRNA","Pvalue.733noRNAvGFPnoRNA")]
l100Q_no_rna<-l100Q_no_rna[which(l100Q_no_rna$L100Q_noRNA_mean_counts>5),]

l100Q_rna<-l100Q_rna[which(l100Q_rna$log2FC.733vsGFP>1 & l100Q_rna$Pvalue.733vGFP<0.05),]
l100Q_no_rna<-l100Q_no_rna[which(l100Q_no_rna$log2FC.733noRNAvsGFPnoRNA>1 & l100Q_no_rna$Pvalue.733noRNAvGFPnoRNA<0.05),]

l100Q_rna<-l100Q_rna[!duplicated(l100Q_rna$PG.Genes),]
l100Q_no_rna<-l100Q_no_rna[!duplicated(l100Q_no_rna$PG.Genes),]

#Mixing them up
wt<-unique(c(wt_rna$PG.Genes,wt_no_rna$PG.Genes))
wt_df<-data.frame("Gene"=wt,"Group"="WT")
wt_df$Class<-ifelse(wt_df$Gene %in% wt_rna$PG.Genes & wt_df$Gene %in% wt_no_rna$PG.Genes, "both", 
                    ifelse(wt_df$Gene %in% wt_rna$PG.Genes, "RNA", "noRNA"))

l100Q<-unique(c(l100Q_rna$PG.Genes,l100Q_no_rna$PG.Genes))
l100Q_df<-data.frame("Gene"=l100Q,"Group"="L100Q")
l100Q_df$Class<-ifelse(l100Q_df$Gene %in% l100Q_rna$PG.Genes & l100Q_df$Gene %in% l100Q_no_rna$PG.Genes, "both", 
                    ifelse(l100Q_df$Gene %in% l100Q_rna$PG.Genes, "RNA", "noRNA"))

comb<-rbind(wt_df,l100Q_df)
comb_summary<-data.frame(table(comb$Group,comb$Class))
comb_summary<-comb_summary %>% mutate(Group=case_when(
  Var2=="both"~"Direct",
  Var2=="noRNA"~"RNA shielded",
  Var2=="RNA"~"RNA mediated"
))
comb_summary$Var1<-factor(comb_summary$Var1,levels=c("WT","L100Q"))
comb_summary$Group<-factor(comb_summary$Group,levels=c("Direct","RNA mediated","RNA shielded"))


#Added part
bind_WT<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/IDR/GG83_GG84_reprod_Meta.bed",sep = "\t")
bind_L100Q<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/IDR/GG87_GG88_reprod_Meta.bed",sep = "\t")
bind_L100Q2<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/IDR/GG93_GG94_reprod_Meta.bed",sep = "\t")

bind_L100Q2$Gene<-sapply(bind_L100Q2$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][1]})
bind_HDR$Gene<-sapply(bind_HDR$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][1]})

table(wt_df$Gene %in% bind_WT$Gene)/nrow(wt_df)
table(wt_df$Gene %in% bind_L100Q$Gene)/nrow(wt_df)
table(wt_df$Gene %in% bind_L100Q2$Gene)/nrow(wt_df)
table(wt_df$Gene %in% bind_HDR$Gene)/nrow(wt_df)

table(l100Q_df$Gene %in% bind_WT$Gene)/nrow(l100Q_df)
table(l100Q_df$Gene %in% bind_L100Q$Gene)/nrow(l100Q_df)
table(l100Q_df$Gene %in% bind_L100Q2$Gene)/nrow(l100Q_df)
table(l100Q_df$Gene %in% bind_HDR$Gene)/nrow(l100Q_df)

l100Q_df_bound<-l100Q_df[which(l100Q_df$Gene %in% bind_L100Q$Gene),]

go<-enrichGO(gene          = l100Q_df_bound$Gene,
                OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                keyType       = 'SYMBOL',
                ont           = "BP",
                universe=prot$PG.Genes,
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff  = 0.1,
                qvalueCutoff  = 0.1)
dotplot(go)

colors<-c("Direct"="#5E5768","RNA shielded"="#E9D985","RNA mediated"="#6B9080")
bind_WT$Gene<-sapply(bind_WT$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][1]})g<-ggplot(comb_summary,aes(x=Var1, y = Freq,fill=Group))+ 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="stack",alpha=0.8,width=0.8, color="black",size=0.15)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors)+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(y="No. of Interacting Proteins")+
  theme(legend.position ="none",
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title= element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title.x= element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.title=element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),

g
```

```{r Fig3A-1, message=F, warning=F,echo=F,fig.width=1, fig.height=1.5}
l100Q_no_rna<-l100Q_no_rna[!duplicated(l100Q_no_rna$PG.Genes),]

#Mixing them up
wt<-unique(c(wt_rna$PG.Genes,wt_no_rna$PG.Genes))
wt_df<-data.frame("Gene"=wt,"Group"="WT")
wt_df$Class<-ifelse(wt_df$Gene %in% wt_rna$PG.Genes & wt_df$Gene %in% wt_no_rna$PG.Genes, "both", 
                    ifelse(wt_df$Gene %in% wt_rna$PG.Genes, "RNA", "noRNA"))

l100Q<-unique(c(l100Q_rna$PG.Genes,l100Q_no_rna$PG.Genes))
l100Q_df<-data.frame("Gene"=l100Q,"Group"="L100Q")
l100Q_df$Class<-ifelse(l100Q_df$Gene %in% l100Q_rna$PG.Genes & l100Q_df$Gene %in% l100Q_no_rna$PG.Genes, "both", 
                    ifelse(l100Q_df$Gene %in% l100Q_rna$PG.Genes, "RNA", "noRNA"))


#getting known interactors
known<-read.table("Figure5/Data/BIOGRID-MV-Physical-4.4.243_Filtered_PCBP1.csv",sep=",")

wt_known<-length(which(wt_df$Gene %in% interactors))/length(wt_df$Gene)
l100_known<-length(which(l100Q_df$Gene %in% interactors))/length(l100Q_df$Gene)

df<-data.frame("Group"=c("WT","L100Q"),"Val"=c(wt_known*100,l100_known*100))
df$Group<-factor(df$Group,levels=c("WT","L100Q"))

ggplot(df, aes(x = Group, y = Val,fill=Group)) +
```

```{r Fig3A-1, message=F, warning=F,echo=F,fig.width=0.8, fig.height=3}
rm(list=ls())
prot<-read.csv("Figure5/Data/20250216_DominguezLab_IP_Imputed_Enrichment_Dataframe.csv",header=T)
prot<-prot[c("PG.Genes",colnames(prot)[grepl("Pvalue|log2FC|Mean|Count",colnames(prot))])]
prot<-prot[which(prot$PG.Genes !=""),]

#Filtering for spectral counts
prot$GFP_mean_counts<-rowMeans(prot[,grep("GFP_0",colnames(prot))],na.rm=T)
prot$GFP_noRNA_mean_counts<-rowMeans(prot[,grep("GFP_noRNA",colnames(prot))],na.rm=T)
prot$WT_mean_counts<-rowMeans(prot[,grep("732_0",colnames(prot))],na.rm=T)
prot$WT_noRNA_mean_counts<-rowMeans(prot[,grep("732_noRNA",colnames(prot))],na.rm=T)
prot$L100Q_mean_counts<-rowMeans(prot[,grep("733_0",colnames(prot))],na.rm=T)
prot$L100Q_noRNA_mean_counts<-rowMeans(prot[,grep("733_noRNA",colnames(prot))],na.rm=T)

RNA<-prot[,c("PG.Genes","WT_mean_counts","L100Q_mean_counts","log2FC.733vs732","Pvalue.733v732")]
noRNA<-prot[,c("PG.Genes","WT_noRNA_mean_counts","L100Q_noRNA_mean_counts","log2FC.733noRNAvs732noRNA","Pvalue.733noRNAv732noRNA")]

RNA<-RNA[which(!grepl(";",RNA$PG.Genes)),]
noRNA<-noRNA[which(!grepl(";",noRNA$PG.Genes)),]
write.table(RNA[order(RNA$log2FC.733vs732,decreasing=T),c(1,4)],"~/Desktop/RNA.rnk",col.names = F,row.names = F,sep="\t",quote = F)
write.table(noRNA[order(noRNA$log2FC.733noRNAvs732noRNA,decreasing=T),c(1,4)],"~/Desktop/noRNA.rnk",col.names = F,row.names = F,sep="\t",quote = F)

#getting localization data
local2<-read.table("Figure5/Data//subcellular_location_data.tsv",sep="\t",header=T)
local2<-local2[which(local2$Reliability != "Uncertain"),]
nuc<-local2[which(grepl("Nucle",local2$Main.location)),]
cyto<-local2[which(grepl("Cyto|Endo|Mitochondria|Golgi",local2$Main.location)),]
Membrane<-local2[which(grepl("Plasma membrane",local2$Main.location)),]

#filtering
RNA<-RNA[which(RNA$WT_mean_counts>5 | RNA$L100Q_mean_counts>5),]
noRNA<-noRNA[which(noRNA$WT_noRNA_mean_counts>5 | noRNA$L100Q_noRNA_mean_counts>5),]

RNA<-RNA[which(abs(RNA$log2FC.733vs732)>1 &RNA$Pvalue.733v732<0.05),]
noRNA<-noRNA[which(abs(noRNA$log2FC.733noRNAvs732noRNA)>1 & noRNA$Pvalue.733noRNAv732noRNA<0.05),]

#Adding localiazation data
RNA<-merge(RNA,local2[c("Gene.name","Main.location","Additional.location")],all.x=T,by.x="PG.Genes",by.y="Gene.name")
noRNA<-merge(noRNA,local2[c("Gene.name","Main.location","Additional.location")],all.x=T,by.x="PG.Genes",by.y="Gene.name")
RNA$All_Location<-paste(RNA$Main.location,RNA$Additional.location,sep=";")
noRNA$All_Location<-paste(noRNA$Main.location,noRNA$Additional.location,sep=";")

#summarizing
RNA<-RNA %>% mutate(Local=case_when(
  grepl("Cyto|Endo|Mitochondria|Golgi|Microtubules|Peroxisomes|Vesicles",All_Location) & grepl("Nucle",All_Location)~"Both",
  grepl("Cyto|Endo|Mitochondria|Golgi|Microtubules|Peroxisomes|Vesicles",All_Location)~"Cytoplasmic",
  grepl("Nucle",All_Location)~"Nuclear",
  grepl("membrane|filaments",All_Location)~"Membrane",
  TRUE~"Other"
))

noRNA<-noRNA %>% mutate(Local=case_when(
  grepl("Cyto|Endo|Mitochondria|Golgi|Microtubules|Peroxisomes|Vesicles",All_Location) & grepl("Nucle",All_Location)~"Both",
  grepl("Cyto|Endo|Mitochondria|Golgi|Microtubules|Peroxisomes|Vesicles",All_Location)~"Cytoplasmic",
  grepl("Nucle",All_Location)~"Nuclear",
  grepl("membrane|filaments",All_Location)~"Membrane",
  TRUE~"Other"
))

#Plotting
common<-read.table("Figure5/Data/MS-IP_Common.txt",header=T)

noRNA<-noRNA[which(noRNA$PG.Genes %in% common$Gene),]
```

```{r Fig3A-1, message=F, warning=F,echo=F,fig.width=1.2, fig.height=2}
rm(list=ls())
df<-read.delim("Figure5/Data/All_peaks_combined.txt")
WT<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/Collapsed/PCBP1_WT_Low_Meta.bed",sep="\t")
L100Q<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/Collapsed/PCBP1_l100_Low_Meta.bed",sep="\t")

#separating by target and making gr
df_sep<-split(df,~Target)
df_sep_gr<-lapply(df_sep, makeGRangesFromDataFrame)

WT_gr<-makeGRangesFromDataFrame(WT,seqnames.field = "V1",start.field = "V2",end.field = "V3",strand.field = "V6")
L100Q_gr<-makeGRangesFromDataFrame(L100Q,seqnames.field = "V1",start.field = "V2",end.field = "V3",strand.field = "V6")

WT_overlaps<-list()
for (n in names(df_sep_gr)){
  ov<-findOverlaps(WT_gr,df_sep_gr[[n]])
  WT_overlaps[[n]]<-length(unique(queryHits(ov)))
}

L100Q_overlaps<-list()
for (n in names(df_sep_gr)){
  ov<-findOverlaps(L100Q_gr,df_sep_gr[[n]])
  L100Q_overlaps[[n]]<-length(unique(queryHits(ov)))
}

WT_overlaps_df<-data.frame(t(data.frame(WT_overlaps)))
L100Q_overlaps_df<-data.frame(t(data.frame(L100Q_overlaps)))

WT_overlaps_df$Genes<-rownames(WT_overlaps_df)
L100Q_overlaps_df$Genes<-rownames(L100Q_overlaps_df)

comb<-merge(WT_overlaps_df,L100Q_overlaps_df,by="Genes")
comb$WT<-comb$t.data.frame.WT_overlaps../length(WT_gr)
comb$L100Q<-comb$t.data.frame.L100Q_overlaps../length(L100Q_gr)
comb<-comb[which(comb$WT>0.1 | comb$L100Q>0.1),]

#clustering
dist_matrix <- dist(comb[c("WT","L100Q")])  # Compute distance matrix (Euclidean by default)
hc_rows <- hclust(dist_matrix)    # Perform hierarchical clustering

# Reorder the rows based on the clustering result
comb_reordered <- comb[hc_rows$order, ]
comb_reordered$Genes[which(comb_reordered$Genes %in% c("LARP4", "DDX59", "AKAP1", "HNRNPK", "PCBP1", "PCBP2"))]<-
  paste0("*",comb_reordered$Genes[which(comb_reordered$Genes %in% c("LARP4", "DDX59", "AKAP1", "HNRNPK", "PCBP1", "PCBP2"))])

comb_long<-melt(comb_reordered[c("Genes","WT","L100Q")],is.vars="Genes")
comb_long$Genes<-factor(comb_long$Genes,levels=comb_reordered$Genes)


# Assign color to specific row labels (e.g., B and D in red)
row_labels <- comb_long$Genes
row_colors <- ifelse(row_labels %in% c("*LARP4", "*DDX59", "*AKAP1", "*HNRNPK", "*PCBP1", "*PCBP2"),"Red","black")
# Create a named vector of HTML-styled labels
row_labels_colored <- setNames(
  paste0("<span style='color:", row_colors, "'>", row_labels, "</span>"),
  row_labels
)



library(ggtext)
g<-ggplot(comb_long, aes(x = variable, y = Genes, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", size = 0.05) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#941D9A") +  # Set color scale
  theme_classic() +
  #scale_y_discrete(labels = row_labels_colored) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black",margin = margin(r = -5)),
        axis.text.y=element_text(family="Arial",size=4, color="black",margin = margin(r = -2)),
        legend.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.title=element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        #axis.text.y = element_markdown(family="Arial",size=4, color="black",margin = margin(r = -2)),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, 'cm'))
g
ggsave("Figure4/ENCODE_ov.pdf",g,width = 1,height=2)

leg<-get_legend(g+theme(legend.position ="top"))
ggsave("Figure4/ENCODE_ov_Legend.pdf",leg,height=0.4,width=1)

m<-data.frame("Genes"=unique(comb_long$Genes))
m$Group<-c("translation","both","both","translation","splicing","splicing",NA,NA,"splicing","translation","splicing","splicing","translation",NA,"splicing",NA,"translation",
           "both","translation",NA,NA,"translation","translation","translation")
m$Genes<-factor(m$Genes,levels=levels(comb_long$Genes))

g<-ggplot(m, aes(x = "X", y = Genes, fill = Group)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", size = 0.05) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("splicing"="#B57F50","translation"="#94BFBE","both"="#6B5CA5"),na.value = "#00000000") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        legend.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.title=element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, 'cm'))
g
ggsave("Figure4/ENCODE_ov_anottation.pdf",g,width =0.3,height=1.8)

leg<-get_legend(g+theme(legend.position ="right"))
```

```{r, fig.width=3, fig.height=2}
L100Q<-read.table("Figure3/Data/eCLIP/Collapsed/PCBP1_l100_Low_Meta.bed",sep="\t")

PCBP2_L100Q_gr<-makeGRangesFromDataFrame(PCBP2_L100Q,seqnames.field = "V1",start.field = "V2",end.field = "V3",strand.field = "V6",keep.extra.columns = T)
PCBP2_WT_gr<-makeGRangesFromDataFrame(PCBP2_WT,seqnames.field = "V1",start.field = "V2",end.field = "V3",strand.field = "V6",keep.extra.columns = T)
L100Q_gr<-makeGRangesFromDataFrame(L100Q,seqnames.field = "V1",start.field = "V2",end.field = "V3",strand.field = "V6",keep.extra.columns = T)

#overlapping ranges between WT and L100Q
ov<-findOverlaps(PCBP2_L100Q_gr,PCBP2_WT_gr)
PCBP2_L100Q_gr_ov<-PCBP2_L100Q_gr[unique(queryHits(ov))]
PCBP2_WT_gr_ov<-PCBP2_WT_gr[unique(subjectHits(ov))]


#overlaping with PCBP1
wt_pcbp1<-findOverlaps(PCBP2_WT_gr_ov,L100Q_gr)
l100q_pcbp1<-findOverlaps(PCBP2_L100Q_gr_ov,L100Q_gr)

PCBP2_WT_gr_ov_PCBP1<-PCBP2_WT_gr_ov[unique(queryHits(wt_pcbp1))] %>% data.frame()
PCBP2_WT_gr_no_PCBP1<-PCBP2_WT_gr_ov[-unique(queryHits(wt_pcbp1))] %>% data.frame()

PCBP2_L100Q_gr_ov_PCBP1<-PCBP2_L100Q_gr_ov[unique(queryHits(l100q_pcbp1))] %>% data.frame()
PCBP2_L100Q_gr_no_PCBP1<-PCBP2_L100Q_gr_ov[-unique(queryHits(l100q_pcbp1))] %>% data.frame()

PCBP2_WT_gr_ov_PCBP1$Region<-sapply(PCBP2_WT_gr_ov_PCBP1$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})
PCBP2_WT_gr_no_PCBP1$Region<-sapply(PCBP2_WT_gr_no_PCBP1$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})
PCBP2_L100Q_gr_ov_PCBP1$Region<-sapply(PCBP2_L100Q_gr_ov_PCBP1$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})
PCBP2_L100Q_gr_no_PCBP1$Region<-sapply(PCBP2_L100Q_gr_no_PCBP1$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})

#overlaping df
ov_df<-rbind(data.frame("Group"="WT","Val"=PCBP2_WT_gr_ov_PCBP1$V7,"Region"=PCBP2_WT_gr_ov_PCBP1$Region),
             data.frame("Group"="L100Q","Val"=PCBP2_L100Q_gr_ov_PCBP1$V7,"Region"=PCBP2_L100Q_gr_ov_PCBP1$Region))
ov_df$Region[which(ov_df$Region=="CDSFull")]<-"CDS"
ov_df<-ov_df[which(ov_df$Region %in% c("CDS","SS3","SS5","UTR3","UTR5","Intron")),]


cds_test<-ks.test(ov_df$Val[which(ov_df$Group=="WT" & ov_df$Region=="CDS")],ov_df$Val[which(ov_df$Group=="L100Q" & ov_df$Region=="CDS")],exact=T)
ss3_test<-ks.test(ov_df$Val[which(ov_df$Group=="WT" & ov_df$Region=="SS3")],ov_df$Val[which(ov_df$Group=="L100Q" & ov_df$Region=="SS3")],exact=T)
ss5_test<-ks.test(ov_df$Val[which(ov_df$Group=="WT" & ov_df$Region=="SS5")],ov_df$Val[which(ov_df$Group=="L100Q" & ov_df$Region=="SS5")],exact=T)
utr3_test<-ks.test(ov_df$Val[which(ov_df$Group=="WT" & ov_df$Region=="UTR3")],ov_df$Val[which(ov_df$Group=="L100Q" & ov_df$Region=="UTR3")],exact=T)
utr5_test<-ks.test(ov_df$Val[which(ov_df$Group=="WT" & ov_df$Region=="UTR5")],ov_df$Val[which(ov_df$Group=="L100Q" & ov_df$Region=="UTR5")],exact=T)
intron_test<-ks.test(ov_df$Val[which(ov_df$Group=="WT" & ov_df$Region=="Intron")],ov_df$Val[which(ov_df$Group=="L100Q" & ov_df$Region=="Intron")],exact=T)

test_df<-data.frame("Group"=c("CDS","Intron","SS3","SS5","UTR3","UTR5"),
                    "P_val"=c(cds_test$p.value,intron_test$p.value,ss3_test$p.value,ss5_test$p.value,utr3_test$p.value,utr5_test$p.value))
test_df$FDR<-p.adjust(test_df$P_val)
test_df$sigif<-sapply(test_df$FDR,signif,digits=3)
colnames(test_df)[1]<-"Region"
test_df$Label<-sapply(test_df$sigif,function(x){bquote(italic(P)==.(x))})
                      

ggplot(ov_df,aes(x = Val,color=Group))+
  stat_ecdf()+
  facet_wrap(~Region)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("WT" =Parent_col, "L100Q" =L100_col))+
  theme_classic()+
  #geom_text(data=test_df,mapping=aes(x=7,y=0.2,label=sigif,group = Region),inherit.aes = FALSE,vjust = 1.2, colour = "black",family="Arial",size=2)+
  geom_text(data=test_df,mapping=aes(x=7,y=0.2,label=Label,group = Region),inherit.aes = FALSE,vjust = 1.2, colour = "black",family="Arial",size=2,parse=T)+
  labs(x="Peak Enrichment",y="ecdf")+
  theme(legend.position = c("none"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(-0.15, "cm"),
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 6,margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank())
ggsave("Figure4/PCBP2_ov_LFC_y_region.pdf",width = 3.5,height=3)
```

```{r}
df<-read.table("Figure5/Data/MS-IP_WT_Unique.txt",header=T)

df$Local[which(df$Local=="Other")]<-"Unknown"

df$ymax = cumsum(df$fraction)
```

#Figure4C
```{r, fig.width=1.5, fig.height=1.5}
load("HCT_rMATS.RData")

L100Q<-HCT$Parent_L100Q$SE
L100Q_sub<-L100Q[which(L100Q$Total_Count_1>50 & L100Q$Total_Count_2>50),]
L100Q_sub$Group<-"ns"
L100Q_sub$Group[which(L100Q_sub$PValue<0.05 & L100Q_sub$FDR<0.05 & L100Q_sub$IncLevelDifference>0.1)]<-"up"
L100Q_sub$Group[which(L100Q_sub$PValue<0.05 & L100Q_sub$FDR<0.05 & L100Q_sub$IncLevelDifference<(-0.1))]<-"down"

##Volcano Plot
cols <- c("up" = Parent_col, "down" = L100_col, "ns" = "grey") 
sizes <- c("up" = 0.75, "down" = 0.75, "ns" = 0.25) 
alphas <- c("up" = 0.7, "down" = 0.7, "ns" = 0.5)

Up_genes<-as.character(length(which(L100Q_sub$Group=="up")))
Down_genes<-as.character(length(which(L100Q_sub$Group=="down")))

volcano<-L100Q_sub %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = IncLevelDifference,
             y = -log10(FDR),
             fill = Group,
             color=Group,
             size = Group,
             alpha =Group)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.1,0.1),
             linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_color_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_size_manual(values = sizes) + # Modify point size
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) + # Modify point transparency
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-0.4,-0.2,0,0.2,0.4),       
                     limits = c(-0.5, 0.5))+
  lims(y=c(0,40))+
  labs(x=bquote(Delta~PSI(Parent-L100Q-1)))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_text(x=0.3, y=30, label=paste("Skipped \n",Up_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2,family="Arial")+
  geom_text(x=-0.3, y=30, label=paste("Retained \n",Down_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2,family="Arial")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank())
volcano
ggsave("Figure5/Fig5C.png",width=1.5,height=1.5)

```

```{r, fig.width=1.2, fig.height=1.5}
rm(list=ls())
```

```{r}
HCT_KO<-HCT$Parent_KO$SE
HCT_L100Q<-HCT$Parent_L100Q$SE

HCT_KO<-HCT_KO[which(HCT_KO$FDR<0.05 & HCT_KO$PValue<0.05 & abs(HCT_KO$IncLevelDifference)>0.1 
                     & HCT_KO$Total_Count_1>50 & HCT_KO$Total_Count_2>50),]
HCT_L100Q<-HCT_L100Q[which(HCT_L100Q$FDR<0.05 & HCT_L100Q$PValue<0.05 & abs(HCT_L100Q$IncLevelDifference)>0.1
                           & HCT_L100Q$Total_Count_1>50 & HCT_L100Q$Total_Count_2>50),]

HCT_KO$Identifier<-paste(HCT_KO$chr,"_",HCT_KO$exonStart_0base,"-",HCT_KO$exonEnd,"_",HCT_KO$upstreamES,"-",HCT_KO$upstreamEE,"_",
                         HCT_KO$downstreamES,"-",HCT_KO$downstreamEE,"_",HCT_KO$strand,"_",HCT_KO$GeneID,"_",HCT_KO$geneSymbol,sep="")
```

```{r,fig.width=3, fig.height=3}
rm(list=ls())
load("HCT_rMATS.RData")

KO<-HCT$Parent_KO$SE
L1001<-HCT$Parent_L100Q$SE

KO$Identifier<-paste(KO$chr,"_",KO$exonStart_0base,"-",KO$exonEnd,"_",KO$upstreamES,"-",
                     KO$upstreamEE,"_",KO$downstreamES,"-",KO$downstreamEE,"_",KO$strand,"_",
                     KO$GeneID,"_",KO$geneSymbol,sep="")
L1001$Identifier<-paste(L1001$chr,"_",L1001$exonStart_0base,"-",L1001$exonEnd,"_",
                        L1001$upstreamES,"-",L1001$upstreamEE,"_",L1001$downstreamES,"-",
                        L1001$downstreamEE,"_",L1001$strand,"_",L1001$GeneID,"_",L1001$geneSymbol,sep="")
L1002$Identifier<-paste(L1002$chr,"_",L1002$exonStart_0base,"-",L1002$exonEnd,"_",
                        L1002$upstreamES,"-",L1002$upstreamEE,"_",L1002$downstreamES,"-",
                        L1002$downstreamEE,"_",L1002$strand,"_",L1002$GeneID,"_",L1002$geneSymbol,sep="")

                       HDR2$GeneID,"_",HDR2$geneSymbol,sep="")

#selecting events that changed between Parent and L100
L1001_sig<-L1001[which(L1001$PValue<0.05 & L1001$FDR<0.05 & L1001$Total_Count_1>50 & 
                         L1001$Total_Count_2>50 & abs(L1001$IncLevelDifference)>0.1),]
L1002_sig<-L1002[which(L1002$PValue<0.05 & L1002$FDR<0.05 & L1002$Total_Count_1>50 & 
                         L1002$Total_Count_2>50 & abs(L1002$IncLevelDifference)>0.1),]
changed_events<-intersect(L1001_sig$Identifier,L1002_sig$Identifier)

#Getting intersection of events
KO_sub<-KO[which(KO$Identifier %in% changed_events),]
L1001_sub<-L1001[which(L1001$Identifier %in% changed_events),]
L1002_sub<-L1002[which(L1002$Identifier %in% changed_events),]
HDR2_sub<-HDR2[which(HDR2$Identifier %in% changed_events),]

comb<-merge(KO_sub[c("Identifier","IncLevel1","IncLevel2")],
            L1001_sub[c("Identifier","IncLevel1","IncLevel2")],by="Identifier")
comb<-merge(comb,L1002_sub[c("Identifier","IncLevel1","IncLevel2")],by="Identifier")
comb<-merge(comb,HDR2_sub[c("Identifier","IncLevel1","IncLevel2")],by="Identifier")


colnames(comb)<-c("Identifier","WT","KO","WT2","L1001","WT3","L1002","WT4","HDR2")
comb<-comb[c("Identifier","WT","KO","L1001","L1002","HDR2")]


comb <- comb %>% separate(WT, into = c("WT1", "WT2","WT3"), sep = ",")
comb <- comb %>% separate(KO, into = c("KO1", "KO2","KO3"), sep = ",")
comb <- comb %>% separate(L1001, into = c("L10011", "L10012","L10013"), sep = ",")
comb <- comb %>% separate(L1002, into = c("L10021", "L10022","L10023"), sep = ",")
comb <- comb %>% separate(HDR2, into = c("HDR21", "HDR22","HDR23"), sep = ",")
rownames(comb)<-comb$Identifier
comb<-comb[,-1]
comb<-as.data.frame(sapply(comb,as.numeric))


legeng<-data.frame(colnames(comb))

rownames(legeng)<-legeng$colnames.comb.
```

```{r,fig.width=1.5, fig.height=1.5}
load("HCT_rMATS.RData")
L100_1<-HCT$Parent_L100Q$SE
L100_2<-HCT$Parent_F10$SE

L100_1<-L100_1[which(L100_1$Total_Count_1>100 & L100_1$Total_Count_2>100),]
L100_1<-L100_1[which(L100_1$FDR<0.05 & L100_1$PValue<0.05),]
L100_1<-L100_1[which(abs(L100_1$IncLevelDifference)>0.05),]

L100_2<-L100_2[which(L100_2$Total_Count_1>100 & L100_2$Total_Count_2>100),]
L100_2<-L100_2[which(L100_2$FDR<0.05 & L100_2$PValue<0.05),]
L100_2<-L100_2[which(abs(L100_2$IncLevelDifference)>0.05),]

L100_1$Identifier<-paste(L100_1$chr,L100_1$exonStart_0base,L100_1$exonEnd,L100_1$upstreamES,L100_1$upstreamEE,L100_1$downstreamES,
                      L100_1$downstreamEE,L100_1$strand,L100_1$GeneID,L100_1$geneSymbol,sep="_")
L100_2$Identifier<-paste(L100_2$chr,L100_2$exonStart_0base,L100_2$exonEnd,L100_2$upstreamES,L100_2$upstreamEE,L100_2$downstreamES,
                      L100_2$downstreamEE,L100_2$strand,L100_2$GeneID,L100_2$geneSymbol,sep="_")
common_events<-unique(c(L100_1$Identifier,L100_2$Identifier))

#Loading TCGA events
SE<-read.table("TCGA_PSI_SE.txt",header = T)
PE<-read.table("TCGA_PSI_PE.txt",header = T)

colnames(SE)<-gsub("[.]","-",colnames(SE))
colnames(PE)<-gsub("[.]","-",colnames(PE))

#removing samples that are in both 
SE<-SE[,which(!colnames(SE) %in% colnames(PE))]

#checking
table(rownames(SE) %in%common_events)
table(rownames(PE) %in% common_events)

SE_sub<-SE[which(rownames(SE) %in% common_events),]
PE_sub<-PE[which(rownames(PE) %in% common_events),]
common_identifiers<-intersect(rownames(SE_sub),rownames(PE_sub))
table(rownames(SE_sub) %in% rownames(PE_sub))
SE_sub<-SE_sub[common_identifiers,]
PE_sub<-PE_sub[common_identifiers,]
table(rownames(SE_sub) == rownames(PE_sub))
all_PSI<-cbind(SE_sub,PE_sub)

###plotting each event
mut<-read.delim("TCGA_mutation.txt",header=T)
mut$Sample<-sapply(mut$Sample.ID,function(x){y<-strsplit(x,"-")[[1]];return(paste(y[1:3],collapse="-"))})
mut<-mut[which(mut$Protein_APC==1),]
mut$Sample.ID<-sapply(mut$Sample.ID,function(x){paste(strsplit(x,"-")[[1]][1:3],collapse = "-")})
mut<-mut[which(mut$Sample.ID %in% colnames(all_PSI)),]
mut$Sample.ID<-sapply(mut$Sample.ID,function(x){paste(strsplit(x,"-")[[1]][1:3],collapse = "-")})
l100_samples<-mut$Sample.ID[which(mut$Protein.Change %in% c("L100P","L100Q","L102P","L102Q","L102R"))]
rest<-setdiff(mut$Sample.ID,l100_samples)

table(l100_samples %in% names(all_PSI))
table(rest %in% names(all_PSI))
table(rest %in% l100_samples)

#Getting the test and pval
p_val<-c()
difference<-c()
id<-c()
for (i in rownames(all_PSI)){
  l<-unlist(as.vector(all_PSI[i,l100_samples]))
  o<-unlist(as.vector(all_PSI[i,rest]))
  test<-ks.test(l,o)
  p_val<-c(p_val,test$p.value)
  difference<-c(difference,mean(o,na.rm=T)-mean(l,na.rm=T))
  id<-c(id,i)
}
df<-data.frame(id,difference,p_val)
df$FDR<-p.adjust(df$p_val,method="fdr")
df$Group<-ifelse(df$FDR>0.05,"ns",ifelse(df$difference>0,"up","down"))

df<-merge(df,L100_1[c("Identifier","IncLevelDifference")],by.x="id",by.y="Identifier",all.x=T)
df<-merge(df,L100_2[c("Identifier","IncLevelDifference")],by.x="id",by.y="Identifier",all.x=T)
df$Group[which(df$Group=="down" & df$IncLevelDifference.y>0)]<-"diff"


cols <- c("up" = Parent_col, "down" = L100_col, "ns" = "grey","diff"="black") 
sizes <- c("up" = 0.75, "down" = 0.75, "ns" = 0.25,"diff"=0.75) 
alphas <- c("up" = 0.7, "down" = 0.7, "ns" = 0.5,"diff"=0.7)

Up_genes<-as.character(length(which(df$Group=="up")))
Down_genes<-as.character(length(which(df$Group=="down")))

sig_genes<-df[which(df$id %in% c("chr19_45413962_45414034_45413433_45413745_45414860_45414960_-_ENSG00000012061_ERCC1",
                                 "chr14_23089981_23090101_23081747_23081836_23090521_23090633_-_ENSG00000100813_ACIN1")),]
sig_genes$name<-sapply(sig_genes$id,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][10]})
sig_genes$color<-"orange"

volcano<-df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = difference,
             y = -log10(FDR),
             fill = Group,
             color=Group,
             size = Group,
             alpha =Group)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0),
             linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_color_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_size_manual(values = sizes) + # Modify point size
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) + # Modify point transparency
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-0.3,-0.15,0,0.15,0.3),       
                     limits = c(-0.3, 0.3))+
  lims(y=c(0,7.5))+
  labs(x=bquote(Delta~PSI(WT-Mut.PCBP1)))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_point(data=sig_genes,aes(x = difference,y = -log10(FDR)),color="black",fill=Parent_col,shape = 21) +
  geom_text_repel(data=sig_genes,aes(x=difference,y=-log10(FDR),label=name),color="black",size=1.5,family="Arial",fill=NA,label.size = NA,nudge_x = 0.15,nudge_y = 0.3,segment.color = "black",segment.size = 0.3,min.segment.length = 0)+
  geom_text(x=0.15, y=6, label=paste("Skipped \n",Up_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2,family="Arial")+
  geom_text(x=-0.15, y=6, label=paste("Retained \n",Down_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2,family="Arial")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank())
volcano
ggsave("Figure5/Fig5H.png",volcano,width = 1.5,height = 1.5)
```

#Figure 4K
```{r,fig.width=3, fig.height=3}
rm(list=ls())
PSI<-read.table("Figure4/Round3 RT-PCR txt/ERCC1_PSI.txt",header=T,sep="\t")

PSI$ID<-"ERCC1"
PSI_melt<-melt(PSI,id.vars = "ID")
PSI_melt$variable<-as.character(PSI_melt$variable)
PSI_melt$variable[which(PSI_melt$variable=="L100Q_1")]<-"L100Q-1"
PSI_melt$variable[which(PSI_melt$variable=="L100Q_2")]<-"L100Q-2"
PSI_melt$variable[which(PSI_melt$variable=="Silent_Edit")]<-"Silent"
PSI_melt$variable[which(PSI_melt$variable=="Het_KO")]<-"hetKO"
PSI_melt$variable<-sapply(as.character(PSI_melt$variable),function(x){strsplit(x,"[.]")[[1]][1]})
PSI_melt$variable<-factor(PSI_melt$variable,levels = c("Parent","Silent","L100Q-1","L100Q-2","hetKO","shCTRL","shPCBP1"))
PSI_melt$value<-as.numeric(PSI_melt$value)

m_HCT<-PSI_melt[which(!(PSI_melt$variable %in% c("shCTRL","shPCBP1"))),]
m_sh<-PSI_melt[which(PSI_melt$variable %in% c("shCTRL","shPCBP1")),]

#means
PSI_mean<-aggregate(value ~ variable, data = PSI_melt, FUN = base::mean)

mean_HCT<-PSI_mean[which(!(PSI_mean$variable %in% c("shCTRL","shPCBP1"))),]
mean_sh<-PSI_mean[which(PSI_mean$variable %in% c("shCTRL","shPCBP1")),]

m_HCT$Diff<-mean_HCT$value[which(mean_HCT$variable=="Parent")]-m_HCT$value
m_sh$Diff<-mean_sh$value[which(mean_sh$variable=="shCTRL")]-m_sh$value

comparisons_hct<-list(c("Parent","Silent"),c("Parent","L100Q-1"),c("Parent","L100Q-2"),c("Parent","hetKO"))
comparisons_sh<-list(c("shCTRL","shPCBP1"))
```

```{r,fig.width=1.5, fig.height=2}
PSI_melt$variable[which(PSI_melt$variable=="L100Q_2")]<-"L100Q-2"
```

```{r,fig.width=2, fig.height=1.2}
rm(list=ls())
df<-read.table("Figure5/Data/polysometrace.txt",sep="\t",header=T)

df_melt<-reshape2::melt(df[c("X","Snaps","WT.A","GFP.A","L100Q.A")],id.vars=c("X","Snaps"))
df_melt$variable<-sapply(as.character(df_melt$variable),function(x){strsplit(x,"[.]")[[1]][1]})

min<-df[c("X","Snaps")] %>% group_by(X) %>% summarise(min_value = min(Snaps)) %>% data.frame()
max<-df[c("X","Snaps")] %>% group_by(X) %>% summarise(min_value = max(Snaps)) %>% data.frame()
box<-merge(min,max,by="X")
box$Col<-"00000000"
box$Col[which(box$X==5)]<-"#BFE0DB"
box$Col[which(box$X==7)]<-"#BFE0DB"
box$Col[which(box$X==10)]<-"#C5D4D6"
box$Col[which(box$X==11)]<-"#B4C4CD"
box$Col[which(box$X==12)]<-"#B3BECC"
box$Col[which(box$X==15)]<-"#B2B0C4"
box$Col[which(box$X==16)]<-"#B5A3B4"
box$Col[which(box$X==17)]<-"#B596A0"
box$Label<-ifelse(box$X %in% c(5,7,10,11,12,15,16,17),paste0("F",box$X),NA)


ggplot()+
  geom_rect(inherit.aes = F,data=box,aes(xmin = min_value.x,ymin = -1,xmax=min_value.y,ymax=4,fill=Col),alpha=0.7)+
  scale_fill_identity()+
  geom_text(inherit.aes = F,data=box,aes(x = (min_value.x+min_value.y)/2,y=3.8,label=Label),size=1)+
  geom_line(data=df_melt,aes(x=Snaps,y=value,group=variable,color=variable))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("WT"=Parent_col,"GFP"=GFP_col,"L100Q"=L100_col))+
  lims(y=c(-1,4))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = c(0.1,0.15),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=4, color="black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text=element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"))
ggsave("Figure5/Fig5M.pdf",width=2.5,height=1.3)
```

```{r,fig.width=3, fig.height=3}
rm(list=ls())
DF <-read.table("Figure5/Data/Polysome/LFC_by_conditions.txt")
df<-DF[,grepl("log2",colnames(DF))]
df<-df[,!grepl("F5",colnames(df))]
colnames(df)<-gsub(".log2FoldChange","",colnames(df))

#Filter for sig
sig<-DF[,grepl("padj",colnames(DF))]
sig<-sig[,!grepl("F5",colnames(sig))]
sum<-rowSums(sig<0.05,na.rm = T)
names<-rownames(sig)[which(sum>0)]
df<-df[names,]

#bound
L100_bound<-read.table("Figure5/Data/C2bb_eclip/Mut_Meta_C2_IDR.bed",sep="\t")
WT_bound<-read.table("Figure5/Data/C2bb_eclip/WT_Meta_C2_IDR.bed",sep="\t")

L100_bound$Region<-sapply(L100_bound$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})
WT_bound$Region<-sapply(WT_bound$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})
bound_genes<-union(strsplit(paste(L100_bound$V5,collapse=","),",")[[1]],strsplit(paste(WT_bound$V5,collapse=","),",")[[1]])

#
df_sub<-df[which(rownames(df) %in% bound_genes),]
df_sub<-df_sub[which(rowSums(abs(df_sub)>1)>0),]
legend<-data.frame(colnames(df_sub))
legend$Fraction<-sapply(legend$colnames.df_sub.,function(x){strsplit(x,"[.]")[[1]][1]})
rownames(legend)<-legend$colnames.df_sub.


Fraction<-c("F10"="#C5D4D6","F11"="#B4C4CD","F12"="#B3BECC","F15"="#B2B0C4","F16"="#B5A3B4","F17"="#B596A0")
my_colors<-list("Fraction"=Fraction)
p<-pheatmap::pheatmap(df_sub,show_rownames=F,show_colnames = F, cluster_cols=F, cluster_rows=T,scale="row",
         clustering_distance_rows="euclidean", clustering_distance_cols="euclidean",
         clustering_method="complete",border_color=NA,legend=T,fontsize = 6,gaps_col=6,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#3AAFA9", "white", "#D97700"))(100),annotation_legend = T,annotation_names_col=F,
         annotation_col=legend["Fraction"],annotation_colors = my_colors,treeheight_col =6,treeheight_row=0,silent = TRUE)
p
clusters<-cbind(df_sub, cluster = cutree(p$tree_row, k = 3))


#Adding row annotations
num_of_significant<-data.frame(rowSums(abs(df_sub)>1))
sig_in_wt<-rownames(df_sub)[which(rowSums(abs(df_sub[,grepl("WT",names(df_sub))])>1)>0)]
sig_in_l100<-rownames(df_sub)[which(rowSums(abs(df_sub[,grepl("L100Q",names(df_sub))])>1)>0)]
sig_in<-ifelse((rownames(df_sub) %in% sig_in_wt) & (rownames(df_sub) %in% sig_in_l100),"both",ifelse(rownames(df_sub) %in% sig_in_l100,"L100Q","WT"))


row_legend<-data.frame("name"=rownames(clusters),"Cluster"=clusters$cluster,"Condition"=sig_in,"Count"=num_of_significant$rowSums.abs.df_sub....1.)
rownames(row_legend)<-row_legend$name
Clust<-c("1"="#C58882","2"="#58A4B0","3"="#EAD2AC")
Cond<-c("WT"=Parent_col,"L100Q"=L100_col,"both"="#9032da")

my_colors[["Cluster"]]<-Clust
my_colors[["Condition"]]<-Cond
my_colors[["Count"]]<-colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFFF", "#B93720"))(12)


#adding annotation of significance
genes_to_label<-c("ENSG00000197256","ENSG00000196923","ENSG00000176182","ENSG00000175592","ENSG00000171223","ENSG00000167767","ENSG00000167641","ENSG00000152137","ENSG00000145675","ENSG00000143878","ENSG00000139645","ENSG00000125505","ENSG00000125398","ENSG00000124762",'ENSG00000120738','ENSG00000116604',"ENSG00000063245")
sym<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = genes_to_label,column = "SYMBOL",keytype="ENSEMBL",multiVals = "first")

genes_to_label<-c("ENSG00000197256","ENSG00000196923","ENSG00000167767","ENSG00000167641","ENSG00000145675","ENSG00000143878","ENSG00000139645","ENSG00000125398","ENSG00000124762",'ENSG00000120738')
sym<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = genes_to_label,column = "SYMBOL",keytype="ENSEMBL",multiVals = "first")



names<-rep("",nrow(df_sub))
names[match(genes_to_label,rownames(df_sub))]<-sym

pdf("Figure5/Polysome_LFC_heatmap.pdf",width = 5,height = 6)
pheatmap(df_sub,show_colnames = F, cluster_cols=F, cluster_rows=T,scale="none",labels_row = names,
         clustering_distance_rows="euclidean", clustering_distance_cols="euclidean",
         clustering_method="complete",border_color=NA,legend=T,fontsize = 4,gaps_col=6,fontsize_row = 6,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#3AAFA9", "white", "#D97700"))(100),annotation_legend = T,annotation_names_col=F,
         annotation_col=legend["Fraction"],annotation_row = row_legend[c("Cluster","Condition","Count")],
         annotation_colors = my_colors,treeheight_col =6,treeheight_row=0)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
load("HCT_rMATS.RData")
L100_1<-HCT$Parent_L100Q$SE
L100_2<-HCT$Parent_F10$SE

L100_1<-L100_1[which(L100_1$Total_Count_1>100 & L100_1$Total_Count_2>100),]
L100_1<-L100_1[which(L100_1$FDR<0.05 & L100_1$PValue<0.05),]
L100_1<-L100_1[which(abs(L100_1$IncLevelDifference)>0.05),]

L100_2<-L100_2[which(L100_2$Total_Count_1>100 & L100_2$Total_Count_2>100),]
L100_2<-L100_2[which(L100_2$FDR<0.05 & L100_2$PValue<0.05),]
L100_2<-L100_2[which(abs(L100_2$IncLevelDifference)>0.05),]

L100_1$Identifier<-paste(L100_1$chr,L100_1$exonStart_0base,L100_1$exonEnd,L100_1$upstreamES,L100_1$upstreamEE,L100_1$downstreamES,
                      L100_1$downstreamEE,L100_1$strand,L100_1$GeneID,L100_1$geneSymbol,sep="_")
L100_2$Identifier<-paste(L100_2$chr,L100_2$exonStart_0base,L100_2$exonEnd,L100_2$upstreamES,L100_2$upstreamEE,L100_2$downstreamES,
                      L100_2$downstreamEE,L100_2$strand,L100_2$GeneID,L100_2$geneSymbol,sep="_")
common_events<-unique(c(L100_1$Identifier,L100_2$Identifier))

#Loading TCGA events
SE<-read.table("TCGA_PSI_SE.txt",header = T)
PE<-read.table("TCGA_PSI_PE.txt",header = T)

colnames(SE)<-gsub("[.]","-",colnames(SE))
colnames(PE)<-gsub("[.]","-",colnames(PE))

#removing samples that are in both 
SE<-SE[,which(!colnames(SE) %in% colnames(PE))]

#checking
table(rownames(SE) %in%common_events)
table(rownames(PE) %in% common_events)

SE_sub<-SE[which(rownames(SE) %in% common_events),]
PE_sub<-PE[which(rownames(PE) %in% common_events),]
common_identifiers<-intersect(rownames(SE_sub),rownames(PE_sub))
table(rownames(SE_sub) %in% rownames(PE_sub))
SE_sub<-SE_sub[common_identifiers,]
PE_sub<-PE_sub[common_identifiers,]
table(rownames(SE_sub) == rownames(PE_sub))
all_PSI<-cbind(SE_sub,PE_sub)

###plotting each event
mut<-read.delim("TCGA_mutation.txt",header=T)
mut$Sample<-sapply(mut$Sample.ID,function(x){y<-strsplit(x,"-")[[1]];return(paste(y[1:3],collapse="-"))})

mut$Sample.ID<-sapply(mut$Sample.ID,function(x){paste(strsplit(x,"-")[[1]][1:3],collapse = "-")})
```

#Volcano Plots
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
prot<-read.csv("Figure5/Data/Polysome/20240927-PC1346-Dominguez_Results-Corrected.csv",skip = 1) 
prot<-prot[!duplicated(prot$Genes),]

Parent_vs_L100Q1<-prot[,c("Genes","Log2.fold.change..LQ100.1....Parent","q.value..L100Q.1....Parent","p.value..LQ100.1....Parent")]
Parent_vs_L100Q2<-prot[,c("Genes","Log2.fold.change..LQ100.2....Parent","q.value..L100Q.2....Parent","p.value..LQ100.2....Parent")]
Parent_vs_KO<-prot[,c("Genes","Log2.fold.change..KO...Parent","q.value..KO...Parent","p.value..KO...Parent")]

Parent_vs_L100Q1[,2:4]<-lapply(Parent_vs_L100Q1[,2:4],as.numeric)
Parent_vs_L100Q2[,2:4]<-lapply(Parent_vs_L100Q2[,2:4],as.numeric)
Parent_vs_KO[,2:4]<-lapply(Parent_vs_KO[,2:4],as.numeric)

colnames(Parent_vs_L100Q1)<-c("Genes","LFC","qval","pval")
colnames(Parent_vs_L100Q2)<-c("Genes","LFC","qval","pval")
colnames(Parent_vs_KO)<-c("Genes","LFC","qval","pval")


Parent_vs_L100Q1$ENSG<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = Parent_vs_L100Q1$Genes,column = "ENSEMBL",keytype="SYMBOL",multiVals = "first")
Parent_vs_L100Q2$ENSG<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = Parent_vs_L100Q2$Genes,column = "ENSEMBL",keytype="SYMBOL",multiVals = "first")
Parent_vs_KO$ENSG<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = Parent_vs_KO$Genes,column = "ENSEMBL",keytype="SYMBOL",multiVals = "first")


Parent_vs_L100Q1<-Parent_vs_L100Q1[which(Parent_vs_L100Q1$ENSG %in% bound),]
Parent_vs_L100Q2<-Parent_vs_L100Q2[which(Parent_vs_L100Q2$ENSG %in% bound),]
Parent_vs_KO<-Parent_vs_KO[which(Parent_vs_KO$ENSG %in% bound),]


Parent_vs_L100Q_sig<-Parent_vs_L100Q1[which(Parent_vs_L100Q1$qval<0.05),]
Parent_vs_L100Q2_sig<-Parent_vs_L100Q2[which(Parent_vs_L100Q2$qval<0.05),]
Parent_vs_KO_sig<-Parent_vs_KO[which(Parent_vs_KO$qval<0.05),]

table(Parent_vs_L100Q_sig$Genes %in% Parent_vs_L100Q2_sig$Genes)




Parent_vs_L100Q_sig$ENSG<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = Parent_vs_L100Q_sig$Genes,column = "ENSEMBL",keytype="SYMBOL",multiVals = "first")
Parent_vs_L100Q2_sig$ENSG<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = Parent_vs_L100Q2_sig$Genes,column = "ENSEMBL",keytype="SYMBOL",multiVals = "first")
Parent_vs_KO_sig$ENSG<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = Parent_vs_KO_sig$Genes,column = "ENSEMBL",keytype="SYMBOL",multiVals = "first")

```

#L100Q-1
```{r}
df<-Parent_vs_L100Q1
df$Group<-"ns"
df$Group[which(df$qval<0.05 & df$LFC>.6)]<-"up"
df$Group[which(df$qval<0.05 & df$LFC<(-.6))]<-"down"

##Volcano Plot
cols <- c("up" = L100_col, "down" = Parent_col, "ns" = "grey") 
sizes <- c("up" = 0.75, "down" = 0.75, "ns" = 0.25) 
alphas <- c("up" = 0.7, "down" = 0.7, "ns" = 0.5)

Up_genes<-as.character(length(which(df$Group=="up")))
Down_genes<-as.character(length(which(df$Group=="down")))

volcano<-df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = LFC,
             y = -log10(qval),
             fill = Group,
             color=Group,
             size = Group,
             alpha =Group)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-.6,.6),
             linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_color_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_size_manual(values = sizes) + # Modify point size
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) + # Modify point transparency
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-4,-2,0,2,4),       
                     limits = c(-5.5, 5.5))+
  lims(y=c(0,4))+
  labs(x="L2FC (L100Q-1 / Parent)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_text(x=3, y=3.5, label=paste("Up \n",Up_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2,family="Arial")+
  geom_text(x=-3, y=3.5, label=paste("Down \n",Down_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2,family="Arial")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=8, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=8, color="black"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank())
volcano
ggsave("Translation_Figure/HCT_L100Q_1_volcano.png",width=1.75,height=1.5)

```

```{r}
  ggplot(aes(x = LFC,
             y = -log10(qval),
             fill = Group,
             color=Group,
             size = Group,
             alpha =Group)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-.6,.6),
             linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_color_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_size_manual(values = sizes) + # Modify point size
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) + # Modify point transparency
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-4,-2,0,2,4),       
                     limits = c(-5.5, 5.5))+
  lims(y=c(0,4))+
  labs(x="L2FC (hetKO / Parent)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_text(x=3, y=3.5, label=paste("Up \n",Up_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2,family="Arial")+
  geom_text(x=-3, y=3.5, label=paste("Down \n",Down_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2,family="Arial")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=8, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=8, color="black"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank())
volcano
ggsave("Translation_Figure/HCT_KO_volcano.png",width=1.75,height=1.5)
```

```{r}
#Correlation

comb2<-merge(Parent_vs_L100Q1[c("Genes","LFC")],Parent_vs_L100Q2[c("Genes","LFC")],by="Genes")

colnames(comb2)<-c("Genes","WT","L100Q")

  geom_point(data=comb2,aes(x=WT,y=L100Q),size=0.25,alpha=0.5,color="gray")+
```

```{r,fig.width=1,fig.height=1}
rm(list=ls())
df<-read.csv("../Omics-data/Proteomics/C2BB/250421_DominguezLab_TotalProteome_Candidates_BroadThresholds.csv")
WT<-df[which(df$Comparison..group1.group2.=="WT / GFP"),]
L100Q<-df[which(df$Comparison..group1.group2.=="L100Q / GFP"),]

WT_sig<-WT[which(WT$Absolute.AVG.Log2.Ratio>0.6 & WT$Qvalue<0.05),]
L100Q_sig<-L100Q[which(L100Q$Absolute.AVG.Log2.Ratio>0.6 & L100Q$Qvalue<0.05),]

CE<-list("WT"=WT_sig$Genes,"L100Q"=L100Q_sig$Genes)
venn<-ggvenn::ggvenn(CE,fill_color=c(Parent_col,L100_col),set_name_size=3,show_percentage=F,text_size=2,fill_alpha=0.5,stroke_size=0.5)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1.2, 1.5))+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=0, color="black"),
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=0, color="black"))

comb2<-merge(WT[c("Genes","AVG.Log2.Ratio")],L100Q[c("Genes","AVG.Log2.Ratio")],by="Genes")
comb2<-comb2[which(comb2$Genes %in% c(WT_sig$Genes,L100Q_sig$Genes)),]

colnames(comb)<-c("Genes","WT","L100Q")
colnames(comb2)<-c("Genes","WT","L100Q")

sig_genes<-comb2[which(comb2$Genes %in% c("CEACAM1","SOX9","CD44")),]

                  label.size = NA,nudge_x = 0.4,nudge_y = 0.1,segment.color = "black",segment.size = 0.3,min.segment.length = 0)+

  scale_color_manual(values=c("both"="black","WT"=Parent_col,"MUT"=L100_col))+
```
