#Trace
```{r,fig.width=3, fig.height=1.5}
rm(list=ls())
df<-read.table("Figure5/Data/polysometrace.txt",sep="\t",header=T)

df_melt<-reshape2::melt(df[c("X","Snaps","WT.A","GFP.A","L100Q.A")],id.vars=c("X","Snaps"))
df_melt$variable<-sapply(as.character(df_melt$variable),function(x){strsplit(x,"[.]")[[1]][1]})

min<-df[c("X","Snaps")] %>% group_by(X) %>% summarise(min_value = min(Snaps)) %>% data.frame()
max<-df[c("X","Snaps")] %>% group_by(X) %>% summarise(min_value = max(Snaps)) %>% data.frame()
box<-merge(min,max,by="X")
box$Col<-"00000000"
box$Col[which(box$X==5)]<-"#BFE0DB"
box$Col[which(box$X==7)]<-"#BFE0DB"
box$Col[which(box$X==10)]<-"#C5D4D6"
box$Col[which(box$X==11)]<-"#B4C4CD"
box$Col[which(box$X==12)]<-"#B3BECC"
box$Col[which(box$X==15)]<-"#B2B0C4"
box$Col[which(box$X==16)]<-"#B5A3B4"
box$Col[which(box$X==17)]<-"#B596A0"
box$Label<-ifelse(box$X %in% c(5,7,10,11,12,15,16,17),paste0("F",box$X),NA)


ggplot()+
  geom_rect(inherit.aes = F,data=box,aes(xmin = min_value.x,ymin = -1,xmax=min_value.y,ymax=4,fill=Col),alpha=0.7)+
  scale_fill_identity()+
  geom_text(inherit.aes = F,data=box,aes(x = (min_value.x+min_value.y)/2,y=3.8,label=Label),size=1.5)+
  geom_line(data=df_melt,aes(x=Snaps,y=value,group=variable,color=variable))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("WT"=Parent_col,"GFP"=GFP_col,"L100Q"=L100_col))+
  lims(y=c(-1,4))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = c(0.08,0.15),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=4, color="black"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text=element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"))
ggsave("Translation_Figure/Trace.pdf",width=3,height=1.3)
```

```{r}
rm(list=ls())

#poly
df<-read.table("../Omics-data/Polysome/Combined_polysome_GE.txt",header=T)
df$Condition<-sapply(df$Fraction,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})
df$Fraction<-sapply(df$Fraction,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][1]})
df<-df[which(df$Fraction !="F5"),]

WT<-df[which(df$Condition=="WT"),]
L100Q<-df[which(df$Condition=="L100Q"),]

comb<-merge(WT[c("Genes","log2FoldChange","gene_type","Fraction")],L100Q[c("Genes","log2FoldChange","gene_type","Fraction")],by=c("Genes","Fraction"))
comb2<-comb[which(comb$gene_type.x!="ns" | comb$gene_type.y !="ns"),]
comb<-comb[which(comb$gene_type.x!="ns" & comb$gene_type.y !="ns"),]

ggplot()+
  geom_point(data=comb2,aes(x=log2FoldChange.x,y=log2FoldChange.y),size=0.25,alpha=0.5,color="gray")+
  geom_point(data=comb,aes(x=log2FoldChange.x,y=log2FoldChange.y),size=0.25,alpha=0.5,color="black")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dotted", size = .5)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dotted", size = .5)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("both"="black","WT"=Parent_col,"MUT"=L100_col))+
  stat_cor(inherit.aes=F,data=comb,aes(x=log2FoldChange.x,y=log2FoldChange.y),method = "spearman",size = 2,family="Arial")+
  theme_classic()+
  facet_wrap(~Fraction,nrow=1)+
  lims(x=c(-6,6),y=c(-6,6))+
  labs(x="LFC (WT / GFP)",y="LFC (L100Q / GFP)")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title= element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        plot.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black",hjust=0.5),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.title=element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank())
ggsave("Translation_Figure/Polysome_WT_L100Q_corr.pdf",width=6,height=1.5)
```

#L2FC by proteomic changes
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
prot<-read.csv("../Omics-data/Proteomics/C2BB/250421_DominguezLab_TotalProteome_Candidates_BroadThresholds.csv")
prot$ENSG<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = prot$Genes,column = "ENSEMBL",keytype="SYMBOL",multiVals = "first")

WT_prot<-prot[which(prot$Comparison..group1.group2.=="WT / GFP"),]
L100Q_prot<-prot[which(prot$Comparison..group1.group2.=="L100Q / GFP"),]

#WT_prot<-WT_prot[which(WT_prot$Absolute.AVG.Log2.Ratio>0.6 & WT_prot$Qvalue<0.05),]
#L100Q_prot<-L100Q_prot[which(L100Q_prot$Absolute.AVG.Log2.Ratio>0.6 & L100Q_prot$Qvalue<0.05),]

#Binding
L100_bound<-read.table("../Omics-data/Binding/PCBP1/eCLIP/C2BB/Mut_Meta_C2_IDR.bed",sep="\t")
WT_bound<-read.table("../Omics-data/Binding/PCBP1/eCLIP/C2BB/WT_Meta_C2_IDR.bed",sep="\t")

L100_bound$Region<-sapply(L100_bound$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})
WT_bound$Region<-sapply(WT_bound$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})
comb<-rbind(L100_bound,WT_bound)

UTR3<-comb[which(comb$Region=="UTR3"),]
UTR5<-comb[which(comb$Region=="UTR5"),]
CDS<-comb[which(comb$Region=="CDS" | comb$Region=="CDSFull"),]
Other<-comb[which(comb$Region=="Intron" | comb$Region=="SS3" |  comb$Region=="SS5"),]

UTR3_genes<-unique(strsplit(paste(UTR3$V5,collapse=","),split=",")[[1]])
UTR5_genes<-unique(strsplit(paste(UTR5$V5,collapse=","),split=",")[[1]])
CDS_genes<-unique(strsplit(paste(CDS$V5,collapse=","),split=",")[[1]])
Other_genes<-unique(strsplit(paste(Other$V5,collapse=","),split=",")[[1]])

WT_prot$Group<-"WT"
WT_prot$Region<-"Unbound"
WT_prot$Region[which(WT_prot$ENSG %in% Other_genes)]<-"Intron"
WT_prot$Region[which(WT_prot$ENSG %in% CDS_genes)]<-"CDS"
WT_prot$Region[which(WT_prot$ENSG %in% UTR5_genes)]<-"UTR5"
WT_prot$Region[which(WT_prot$ENSG %in% UTR3_genes)]<-"UTR3"

L100Q_prot$Group<-"L100Q"
L100Q_prot$Region<-"Unbound"
L100Q_prot$Region[which(L100Q_prot$ENSG %in% Other_genes)]<-"Intron"
L100Q_prot$Region[which(L100Q_prot$ENSG %in% CDS_genes)]<-"CDS"
L100Q_prot$Region[which(L100Q_prot$ENSG %in% UTR5_genes)]<-"UTR5"
L100Q_prot$Region[which(L100Q_prot$ENSG %in% UTR3_genes)]<-"UTR3"

both<-rbind(WT_prot,L100Q_prot)
both$Region<-factor(both$Region,levels=c("UTR3","UTR5","CDS","Intron","Unbound"))


ggplot(both,aes(x=Region,y=AVG.Log2.Ratio,fill=Group))+
  geom_violin()

table(both$Group,both$Region)

m<-both[which(both$Region=="UTR5"),]
```

#Ranked order list
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
L100_bound<-read.table("../Omics-data/Binding/PCBP1/eCLIP/C2BB/Mut_Meta_C2_IDR.bed",sep="\t")
L100_bound$Genes<-sapply(L100_bound$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][1]})
L100_bound$Region<-sapply(L100_bound$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})


L100_bound<-L100_bound[which(L100_bound$Region=="UTR3"),]
L100_bound_grouped <- L100_bound %>% group_by(Genes) %>%summarise(total = sum(V7)) %>% data.frame()

#prot
prot<-read.csv("../Omics-data/Proteomics/C2BB/250421_DominguezLab_TotalProteome_Candidates_BroadThresholds.csv")
prot$ENSG<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = prot$Genes,column = "ENSEMBL",keytype="SYMBOL",multiVals = "first")

WT_prot<-prot[which(prot$Comparison..group1.group2.=="WT / GFP"),]
L100Q_prot<-prot[which(prot$Comparison..group1.group2.=="L100Q / GFP"),]

#mgerging
L100_WT<-merge(L100_bound_grouped,WT_prot[c("AVG.Log2.Ratio","Absolute.AVG.Log2.Ratio","Genes")],by="Genes")
L100_L100<-merge(L100_bound_grouped,L100Q_prot[c("AVG.Log2.Ratio","Absolute.AVG.Log2.Ratio","Genes")],by="Genes")

L100_WT<-L100_WT %>% mutate(quantile_group = ntile(total, 5))
L100_L100<-L100_L100 %>% mutate(quantile_group = ntile(total, 5))

L100_WT$quantile_group<-as.character(L100_WT$quantile_group)
L100_L100$quantile_group<-as.character(L100_L100$quantile_group)

g1<-ggplot(L100_WT[which(L100_WT$AVG.Log2.Ratio>0),],aes(x=AVG.Log2.Ratio,group=quantile_group,color=quantile_group))+
  stat_ecdf()+
  ggtitle("WT_pos")
  
g2<-ggplot(L100_WT[which(L100_WT$AVG.Log2.Ratio<0),],aes(x=abs(AVG.Log2.Ratio),group=quantile_group,color=quantile_group))+
  stat_ecdf()+
  ggtitle("WT_neg")

g3<-ggplot(L100_L100[which(L100_L100$AVG.Log2.Ratio>0),],aes(x=AVG.Log2.Ratio,group=quantile_group,color=quantile_group))+
  stat_ecdf()+
  ggtitle("L100Q_pos")
  
g4<-ggplot(L100_L100[which(L100_L100$AVG.Log2.Ratio<0),],aes(x=abs(AVG.Log2.Ratio),group=quantile_group,color=quantile_group))+
  stat_ecdf()+
  ggtitle("L100Q_neg")


ggarrange(g1,g2,g3,g4,nrow=1)
```

```{r}
#Correlation
```

```{r}
comb2<-merge(WT[c("Genes","AVG.Log2.Ratio")],L100Q[c("Genes","AVG.Log2.Ratio")],by="Genes")
comb2<-comb2[which(comb2$Genes %in% c(WT_sig$Genes,L100Q_sig$Genes)),]

colnames(comb)<-c("Genes","WT","L100Q")
colnames(comb2)<-c("Genes","WT","L100Q")

sig_genes<-comb2[which(comb2$Genes %in% c("IFIT3","CEACAM1","SOX9")),]
sig_genes$color<-"orange"

ggplot()+
  geom_point(data=comb2,aes(x=WT,y=L100Q),size=0.25,alpha=0.5,color="gray")+
  geom_point(data=comb,aes(x=WT,y=L100Q),size=0.25,alpha=0.5,color="black")+
  geom_point(data=sig_genes,aes(x = WT,y = L100Q),color="black",fill=Parent_col,shape = 21,size=.8) +
  geom_text_repel(data=sig_genes,aes(x=WT,y=L100Q,label=Genes),color="red",size=1.5,family="Arial",fill="gray",,
                  label.size = NA,nudge_x = 0.4,nudge_y = 0.1,segment.color = "black",segment.size = 0.3,min.segment.length = 0)+
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "bla", linetype = "dotted", size = .5)+
  #geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray", linetype = "dotted", size = .5)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("both"="black","WT"=Parent_col,"MUT"=L100_col))+
  stat_cor(inherit.aes=F,data=comb,aes(x=WT,y=L100Q),method = "spearman",size = 2,family="Arial")+
  theme_classic()+
  lims(x=c(-6,6),y=c(-6,6))+
  labs(x="LFC (WT / GFP)",y="LFC (L100Q / GFP)")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
```

```{r}
df<-read.csv("../Omics-data/Proteomics/C2BB/250421_DominguezLab_TotalProteome_Candidates_BroadThresholds.csv")
df$ENSG<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = df$Genes,column = "ENSEMBL",keytype="SYMBOL",multiVals = "first")

L100Q<-df[which(df$Comparison..group1.group2.=="L100Q / GFP"),]

WT_sig<-WT[which(WT$Absolute.AVG.Log2.Ratio>0.6 & WT$Qvalue<0.05),]
L100Q_sig<-L100Q[which(L100Q$Absolute.AVG.Log2.Ratio>0.6 & L100Q$Qvalue<0.05),]

WT_unique<-setdiff(WT_sig$Genes,L100Q_sig$Genes)
L100Q_unique<-setdiff(L100Q_sig$Genes,WT_sig$Genes)
common<-intersect(L100Q_sig$Genes,WT_sig$Genes)


WT_u <-enrichGO(gene          = WT_unique,
                 OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                 keyType       = 'SYMBOL',
                 ont           = "BP",
                 pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                 universe     = df$Genes,
                 pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                 qvalueCutoff  = 0.05)
dotplot(WT_u,showCategory=25)


L100Q_u <-enrichGO(gene          = L100Q_unique,
                 OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                 keyType       = 'SYMBOL',

                 universe     = df$Genes,
                 pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                 qvalueCutoff  = 0.05)
dotplot(L100Q_u,showCategory=25)

commo_u  <-enrichGO(gene          = common,
                 OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
```

#VOlcano plot for GE-WT
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
df<-read.table("../Omics-data/RNA-seq-expression/C2BBe1/WT_vs_GFP_Whole.txt",header = T)

##Volcano Plot
cols <- c("up" = Parent_col, "down" = GFP_col, "ns" = "grey") 
sizes <- c("up" = 0.75, "down" = 0.75, "ns" = 0.25) 
alphas <- c("up" = 0.7, "down" = 0.7, "ns" = 0.5)

Up_genes<-as.character(length(which(df$gene_type=="up")))
Down_genes<-as.character(length(which(df$gene_type=="down")))

volcano<-df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange,
             y = -log10(padj),
             fill = gene_type,
             color=gene_type,
             size = gene_type,
             alpha =gene_type)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1,1),
             linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_color_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_size_manual(values = sizes) + # Modify point size
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) + # Modify point transparency
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-4,-2,0,2,4),       
                     limits = c(-4.5, 4.5))+
  lims(y=c(0,6))+
  labs(x="LFC (WT / GFP)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_text(x=3, y=5.5, label=paste("Up \n",Up_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2,family="Arial")+
  geom_text(x=-3, y=5.5, label=paste("Down \n",Down_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2,family="Arial")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(family="Arial",size=6, color="black"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank())
volcano
ggsave("Translation_Figure/C2BB_WT_GFP_GE.png",width=1.75,height=1.5)
```

#Figure 6

#6A
```{r Fig3A-1, message=F, warning=F,echo=F,fig.width=1.5, fig.height=1.5}
rm(list=ls())
df<-read.table("Figure6/C2_Growth/C2_Growth_R copy.txt",header=T,sep="\t")
df<-df[c(1:10)]
colnames(df)<-c("Time","WT1","WT2","WT3","L100Q1","L100Q2","L100Q3","GFP1","GFP2","GFP3")
df<-df[-1,]

df_numeric <- mutate_all(df, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

df_numeric$WT<-rowMeans(df_numeric[c("WT1","WT2","WT3")],na.rm = T)
df_numeric$L100Q<-rowMeans(df_numeric[c("L100Q1","L100Q2","L100Q3")],na.rm = T)
df_numeric$GFP<-rowMeans(df_numeric[c("GFP1","GFP2","GFP3")],na.rm = T)

df_numeric$WT_SD<-apply(df_numeric[c("WT1","WT2","WT3")],1,sd,na.rm = T)
df_numeric$L100Q_SD<-apply(df_numeric[c("L100Q1","L100Q2","L100Q3")],1,sd,na.rm = T)
df_numeric$GFP_SD<-apply(df_numeric[c("GFP1","GFP2","GFP3")],1,sd,na.rm = T)

df_numeric$WT_SE<-df_numeric$WT_SD/sqrt(3)
df_numeric$L100Q_SE<-df_numeric$L100Q_SD/sqrt(3)
```

```{r Fig3A-1, message=F, warning=F,echo=F,fig.width=1.5, fig.height=1.5}
rm(list=ls())
```

```{r}
fit <- survfit(surv_obj ~ variable, data = df_melt)

# Plot the survival curve using ggsurvplot (ggplot2-based)
ggsurvplot(fit,
           data = df_melt,
           pval = TRUE,
           pval.size = 2,
           conf.int = F,       
           risk.table = F,
           legend = "none",
           ggtheme = theme_classic(base_family = "Arial",base_size = 6),  # ggplot2 theme
           palette = c(Parent_col,"#921A1D"), # Custom colors
           legend.labs = c("WT","L100Q"),size=0.5)
```

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
prot<-read.csv("../Omics-data/Proteomics/20240927-PC1346-Dominguez_Results-Corrected.csv",skip = 1) 
prot<-prot[!duplicated(prot$Genes),]

Parent_vs_L100Q1<-prot[,c("Genes","Log2.fold.change..LQ100.1....Parent","q.value..L100Q.1....Parent","p.value..LQ100.1....Parent")]
Parent_vs_L100Q2<-prot[,c("Genes","Log2.fold.change..LQ100.2....Parent","q.value..L100Q.2....Parent","p.value..LQ100.2....Parent")]
Parent_vs_KO<-prot[,c("Genes","Log2.fold.change..KO...Parent","q.value..KO...Parent","p.value..KO...Parent")]

Parent_vs_L100Q1_sig<-Parent_vs_L100Q1[which(Parent_vs_L100Q1$q.value..L100Q.1....Parent<0.05 & Parent_vs_L100Q1$p.value..LQ100.1....Parent<0.05),] %>% data.frame()
Parent_vs_L100Q2_sig<-Parent_vs_L100Q2[which(Parent_vs_L100Q2$q.value..L100Q.2....Parent<0.05 & Parent_vs_L100Q2$p.value..LQ100.2....Parent<0.05),] %>% data.frame()
Parent_vs_KO_sig<-Parent_vs_KO[which(Parent_vs_KO$q.value..KO...Parent<0.05 & Parent_vs_KO$p.value..KO...Parent<0.05), ]%>% data.frame()

colnames(Parent_vs_L100Q1_sig)<-c("Genes","LFC","pval","qval")
colnames(Parent_vs_L100Q2_sig)<-c("Genes","LFC","pval","qval")
colnames(Parent_vs_KO_sig)<-c("Genes","LFC","pval","qval")

Parent_vs_L100Q1_sig$GeneID<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = Parent_vs_L100Q1_sig$Genes,column = "ENSEMBL",keytype="SYMBOL",multiVals = "first")
Parent_vs_L100Q2_sig$GeneID<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = Parent_vs_L100Q2_sig$Genes,column = "ENSEMBL",keytype="SYMBOL",multiVals = "first")
Parent_vs_KO_sig$GeneID<-mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,keys = Parent_vs_KO_sig$Genes,column = "ENSEMBL",keytype="SYMBOL",multiVals = "first")



table(Parent_vs_L100Q1_sig$Genes %in% L100Q$Genes,Parent_vs_L100Q1_sig$LFC>0)
table(Parent_vs_L100Q2_sig$Genes %in% L100Q$Genes,Parent_vs_L100Q2_sig$LFC>0)
table(Parent_vs_KO_sig$Genes %in% L100Q$Genes,Parent_vs_KO_sig$LFC>0)
```

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
DF <-read.table("Figure5/Data/Polysome/LFC_by_conditions.txt")

F11<-DF[c("F11.WT.log2FoldChange","F11.WT.padj")]
df<-F11
colnames(df)<-c("LFC","padj")
df$Group<-"ns"
df$Group[which(df$padj<0.05 & df$LFC>1)]<-"up"
df$Group[which(df$padj<0.05 & df$LFC<(-1))]<-"down"

#bound
L100_bound<-read.table("Figure5/Data/C2bb_eclip/Mut_Meta_C2_IDR.bed",sep="\t")
WT_bound<-read.table("Figure5/Data/C2bb_eclip/WT_Meta_C2_IDR.bed",sep="\t")
L100_bound$Region<-sapply(L100_bound$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})
WT_bound$Region<-sapply(WT_bound$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})
all_bound_genes<-union(strsplit(paste(L100_bound$V5,collapse=","),",")[[1]],strsplit(paste(WT_bound$V5,collapse=","),",")[[1]])

#Filter
df<-df[which(rownames(df) %in% all_bound_genes),]

##Volcano Plot
cols <- c("up" = "#D97700", "down" = "#3AAFA9", "ns" = "grey") 
sizes <- c("up" = 0.75, "down" = 0.75, "ns" = 0.25) 
alphas <- c("up" = 0.7, "down" = 0.7, "ns" = 0.5)

Up_genes<-as.character(length(which(df$Group=="up")))
Down_genes<-as.character(length(which(df$Group=="down")))

volcano<-df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = LFC,
             y = -log10(padj),
             fill = Group,
             color=Group,
             size = Group,
             alpha =Group)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1,1),
             linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_color_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_size_manual(values = sizes) + # Modify point size
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) + # Modify point transparency
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-4,-2,0,2,4),       
                     limits = c(-4.5, 4.5))+
  lims(y=c(0,50))+
  labs(x="L2FC (WT / GFP)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_text(x=3, y=30, label=paste("Up \n",Up_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2,family="Arial")+
  geom_text(x=-3, y=30, label=paste("Down \n",Down_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2,family="Arial")+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(family="Arial",size=8, color="black"),
```

#Comparing WT and Mut
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
DF <-read.table("Figure5/Data/Polysome/LFC_by_conditions.txt")


#bound
L100_bound<-read.table("Figure5/Data/C2bb_eclip/Mut_Meta_C2_IDR.bed",sep="\t")
WT_bound<-read.table("Figure5/Data/C2bb_eclip/WT_Meta_C2_IDR.bed",sep="\t")
L100_bound$Region<-sapply(L100_bound$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})
WT_bound$Region<-sapply(WT_bound$V4,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][2]})
all_bound_genes<-union(strsplit(paste(L100_bound$V5,collapse=","),",")[[1]],strsplit(paste(WT_bound$V5,collapse=","),",")[[1]])

DF<-DF[which(rownames(DF) %in% all_bound_genes),]

WT<-DF[c("F11.WT.log2FoldChange","F11.WT.padj")]
L100Q<-DF[c("F11.L100Q.log2FoldChange","F11.L100Q.padj")]

WT_sig<-WT[which(abs(WT$F11.WT.log2FoldChange)>1 & WT$F11.WT.padj<0.05),]
L100Q_sig<-L100Q[which(abs(L100Q$F11.L100Q.log2FoldChange)>1 & L100Q$F11.L100Q.padj<0.05),]

changed_genes<-unique(c(rownames(WT_sig),rownames(L100Q_sig)))

changed_genes<-rownames(L100Q_sig)

WT_sub<-WT[changed_genes,]
L100Q_sub<-L100Q[changed_genes,]

table(rownames(WT_sub) == rownames(L100Q_sub))
df<-cbind(WT_sub,L100Q_sub)
plot(df$F11.WT.log2FoldChange,df$F11.L100Q.log2FoldChange)
table(df$F11.WT.log2FoldChange>0,df$F11.L100Q.log2FoldChange>0)

UP<-df[which(df$F11.WT.log2FoldChange>0 & df$F11.L100Q.log2FoldChange>0),]
DOWN<-df[which(df$F11.WT.log2FoldChange<0 & df$F11.L100Q.log2FoldChange<0),]


UP_df<-melt(UP[c("F11.WT.log2FoldChange","F11.L100Q.log2FoldChange")])
UP_df$condition<-sapply(as.character(UP_df$variable),function(x){strsplit(x,"[.]")[[1]][2]})

ggplot(UP_df,aes(y=value,x=condition))+
  geom_boxplot()


DOWN_df<-melt(DOWN[c("F11.WT.log2FoldChange","F11.L100Q.log2FoldChange")])
DOWN_df$condition<-sapply(as.character(DOWN_df$variable),function(x){strsplit(x,"[.]")[[1]][2]})

ggplot(DOWN_df,aes(y=value,x=condition))+
  geom_boxplot()
```

#Just TCGA
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
SE<-read.table("TCGA_PSI_SE.txt")
PE<-read.table("TCGA_PSI_PE.txt")
mut<-read.delim("TCGA_mutation.txt",header=T)
mut$sample<-sapply(mut$Sample.ID,function(x){y<-strsplit(x,"-")[[1]];return(paste(y[1:3],collapse="."))})
mut_sub<-mut[which(mut$Protein_APC ==1),]

pcbp1_mut<-mut_sub[which(mut_sub$Protein.Change %in% c("L100P","L100Q","L102P","L102Q","L102R")),]

#sub
SE<-SE[,which(colnames(SE) %in% mut_sub$sample),]
PE<-PE[,which(colnames(PE) %in% mut_sub$sample),]
SE<-SE[,which(!(colnames(SE) %in% colnames(PE)))]

SE$ID<-rownames(SE)
PE$ID<-rownames(PE)
comb<-merge(SE,PE,by="ID")
rownames(comb)<-comb$ID
comb<-comb[,-1]
pcbp1_mut<-pcbp1_mut[which(pcbp1_mut$sample %in% colnames(comb)),]

#testing
#Getting the test and pval
p_val<-c()
difference<-c()
id<-c()
for (i in rownames(comb)){
  l<-unlist(as.vector(comb[i,pcbp1_mut$sample]))
  o<-unlist(as.vector(comb[i,which(!(colnames(comb) %in% pcbp1_mut$sample))]))
  test<-wilcox.test(l,o)
  p_val<-c(p_val,test$p.value)
  difference<-c(difference,mean(o,na.rm=T)-mean(l,na.rm=T))
  id<-c(id,i)
}
df<-data.frame(id,difference,p_val)
df$FDR<-p.adjust(df$p_val,method="fdr")
df$Group<-"ns"
df$Group[which(df$FDR<0.2 & df$difference<(-0.1))]<-"down"
df$Group[which(df$FDR<0.2 & df$difference>0.1)]<-"up"

#Figure
#
cols <- c("up" = Parent_col, "down" = L100_col, "ns" = "grey","diff"="black") 
sizes <- c("up" = 0.75, "down" = 0.75, "ns" = 0.25,"diff"=0.75) 
alphas <- c("up" = 0.7, "down" = 0.7, "ns" = 0.5,"diff"=0.7)

Up_genes<-as.character(length(which(df$Group=="up")))
Down_genes<-as.character(length(which(df$Group=="down")))

sig_genes<-df[which(df$id %in% c("chr19_45413962_45414034_45413433_45413745_45414860_45414960_-_ENSG00000012061_ERCC1",
                                 "chr14_23089981_23090101_23081747_23081836_23090521_23090633_-_ENSG00000100813_ACIN1")),]
sig_genes$name<-sapply(sig_genes$id,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][10]})
sig_genes$color<-"orange"

volcano<-df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = difference,
             y = -log10(FDR),
             fill = Group,
             color=Group,
             size = Group,
             alpha =Group)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.2),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.1,0.1),
             linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_color_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_size_manual(values = sizes) + # Modify point size
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) + # Modify point transparency
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-0.3,-0.15,0,0.15,0.3),       
                     limits = c(-0.35, 0.35))+
  lims(y=c(0,7.5))+
  labs(x=bquote(Delta~PSI(WT-Mut.PCBP1)))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_point(data=sig_genes,aes(x = difference,y = -log10(FDR)),color="black",fill=Parent_col,shape = 21) +
  geom_text_repel(data=sig_genes,aes(x=difference,y=-log10(FDR),label=name),color="black",size=2,fill=NA,label.size = NA,nudge_x = 0.2,nudge_y = 0.4,segment.color = "black",segment.size = 0.3,min.segment.length = 0)+
  geom_text(x=0.25, y=6, label=paste("Skipped \n",Up_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2)+
  geom_text(x=-0.25, y=6, label=paste("Retained \n",Down_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2)+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=6, color="black"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank())
volcano
ggsave("New_Plots/TCGA_update_volcano.png",volcano,width = 1.5,height = 1.5)
```

#TCGA and HCT
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
SE<-read.table("TCGA_PSI_SE.txt")
PE<-read.table("TCGA_PSI_PE.txt")
mut<-read.delim("TCGA_mutation.txt",header=T)
mut$sample<-sapply(mut$Sample.ID,function(x){y<-strsplit(x,"-")[[1]];return(paste(y[1:3],collapse="."))})
mut_sub<-mut[which(mut$Protein_APC ==1),]

pcbp1_mut<-mut_sub[which(mut_sub$Protein.Change %in% c("L100P","L100Q","L102P","L102Q","L102R")),]

#sub
SE<-SE[,which(colnames(SE) %in% mut_sub$sample),]
PE<-PE[,which(colnames(PE) %in% mut_sub$sample),]
SE<-SE[,which(!(colnames(SE) %in% colnames(PE)))]

SE$ID<-rownames(SE)
PE$ID<-rownames(PE)
comb<-merge(SE,PE,by="ID")
rownames(comb)<-comb$ID
comb<-comb[,-1]
pcbp1_mut<-pcbp1_mut[which(pcbp1_mut$sample %in% colnames(comb)),]

#testing
#Getting the test and pval
p_val<-c()
difference<-c()
id<-c()
for (i in rownames(comb)){
  l<-unlist(as.vector(comb[i,pcbp1_mut$sample]))
  o<-unlist(as.vector(comb[i,which(!(colnames(comb) %in% pcbp1_mut$sample))]))
  test<-ks.test(l,o)
  p_val<-c(p_val,test$p.value)
  difference<-c(difference,mean(o,na.rm=T)-mean(l,na.rm=T))
  id<-c(id,i)
}
df<-data.frame(id,difference,p_val)
df$FDR<-p.adjust(df$p_val,method="fdr")
df$Trend<-"ns"
df$Trend[which(df$FDR<0.2 & df$difference<(-0.1))]<-"down"
df$Trend[which(df$FDR<0.2 & df$difference>0.1)]<-"up"


#loading HCT
load("HCT_rMATS.RData")
L100_1<-HCT$Parent_L100Q$SE
L100_2<-HCT$Parent_F10$SE

L100_1$Identifier<-paste(L100_1$chr,L100_1$exonStart_0base,L100_1$exonEnd,L100_1$upstreamES,L100_1$upstreamEE,L100_1$downstreamES,
                      L100_1$downstreamEE,L100_1$strand,L100_1$GeneID,L100_1$geneSymbol,sep="_")
L100_2$Identifier<-paste(L100_2$chr,L100_2$exonStart_0base,L100_2$exonEnd,L100_2$upstreamES,L100_2$upstreamEE,L100_2$downstreamES,
                      L100_2$downstreamEE,L100_2$strand,L100_2$GeneID,L100_2$geneSymbol,sep="_")

comb2<-merge(L100_1[c("Identifier","IncLevelDifference")],L100_2[c("Identifier","IncLevelDifference")],by="Identifier")

L100_1<-L100_1[which(L100_1$Total_Count_1>100 & L100_1$Total_Count_2>100),]
L100_1<-L100_1[which(L100_1$FDR<0.05 & L100_1$PValue<0.05),]
L100_1<-L100_1[which(abs(L100_1$IncLevelDifference)>0.05),]

L100_2<-L100_2[which(L100_2$Total_Count_1>100 & L100_2$Total_Count_2>100),]
L100_2<-L100_2[which(L100_2$FDR<0.05 & L100_2$PValue<0.05),]
L100_2<-L100_2[which(abs(L100_2$IncLevelDifference)>0.05),]

comb2<-comb2[which(comb2$Identifier %in% c(L100_1$Identifier,L100_2$Identifier)),]

##
mergeed<-merge(df,comb2,by.x="id",by.y="Identifier")
mergeed$Mean<-(mergeed$IncLevelDifference.x+mergeed$IncLevelDifference.y)/2

mergeed$Group<-"gray"
mergeed$Group[which(mergeed$difference*mergeed$Mean>0)]<-"black"
mergeed$Group[which(mergeed$id %in% c("chr19_45413962_45414034_45413433_45413745_45414860_45414960_-_ENSG00000012061_ERCC1",
                                 "chr14_23089981_23090101_23081747_23081836_23090521_23090633_-_ENSG00000100813_ACIN1"))]<-"orange"
mergeed$Gene<-sapply(mergeed$id,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][10]})


ggplot(mergeed,aes(x = difference,y = Mean,color=Group,fill = Group))+
  geom_point(shape = 21,alpha=0.5,size=0.3)+
  lims(x=c(-0.4,.4),y=c(-0.4,.4))+
  scale_fill_identity()+
  scale_colour_identity()+
  labs(x="TCGA (WT-Mut.PCBP1)",y="Mean. HCT (Parent-L100Q)")+
  stat_cor(inherit.aes=F,data=mergeed,aes(x = Mean,y = difference),method = "spearman",size = 2.5,label.x=-.4,label.y=-.35)+
  geom_text_repel(data=mergeed[which(mergeed$Group=="orange"),],aes(x=difference,y=Mean,label=Gene),color="black",size=2,family="Arial",
                  fill=NA,label.size = NA,nudge_x = 0.15,nudge_y = 0.1,segment.color = "black",segment.size = 0.3,min.segment.length = 0)+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=6, color="black"), 
        axis.title = element_text(size=6, color="black"),
        panel.background = element_blank(), 
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank())+
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(1, 'cm'))
ggsave("New_Plots/TCGA_HCT_cor.pdf",width = 1.5,height = 1.5)
```

```{r}
rownames(comb)<-comb$ID
comb<-comb[,-1]
pcbp1_mut<-pcbp1_mut[which(pcbp1_mut$sample %in% colnames(comb)),]

#testing
#Getting the test and pval
p_val<-c()
difference<-c()
id<-c()
for (i in rownames(comb)){
  l<-unlist(as.vector(comb[i,pcbp1_mut$sample]))
  o<-unlist(as.vector(comb[i,which(!(colnames(comb) %in% pcbp1_mut$sample))]))
  test<-wilcox.test(l,o)
  p_val<-c(p_val,test$p.value)
  difference<-c(difference,mean(o,na.rm=T)-mean(l,na.rm=T))
  id<-c(id,i)
}
df<-data.frame(id,difference,p_val)
df$FDR<-p.adjust(df$p_val,method="fdr")
df$Group<-"ns"
df$Group[which(df$FDR<0.2 & df$difference<(-0.1))]<-"down"
df$Group[which(df$FDR<0.2 & df$difference>0.1)]<-"up"

#LoadingHCT
load("HCT_rMATS.RData")
L100_1<-HCT$Parent_L100Q$SE
L100_2<-HCT$Parent_F10$SE

L100_1<-L100_1[which(L100_1$Total_Count_1>100 & L100_1$Total_Count_2>100),]
L100_1<-L100_1[which(L100_1$FDR<0.05 & L100_1$PValue<0.05),]
L100_1<-L100_1[which(abs(L100_1$IncLevelDifference)>0.05),]

L100_2<-L100_2[which(L100_2$Total_Count_1>100 & L100_2$Total_Count_2>100),]
L100_2<-L100_2[which(L100_2$FDR<0.05 & L100_2$PValue<0.05),]
L100_2<-L100_2[which(abs(L100_2$IncLevelDifference)>0.05),]

L100_1$Identifier<-paste(L100_1$chr,L100_1$exonStart_0base,L100_1$exonEnd,L100_1$upstreamES,L100_1$upstreamEE,L100_1$downstreamES,
                      L100_1$downstreamEE,L100_1$strand,L100_1$GeneID,L100_1$geneSymbol,sep="_")
L100_2$Identifier<-paste(L100_2$chr,L100_2$exonStart_0base,L100_2$exonEnd,L100_2$upstreamES,L100_2$upstreamEE,L100_2$downstreamES,
                      L100_2$downstreamEE,L100_2$strand,L100_2$GeneID,L100_2$geneSymbol,sep="_")
common_events<-unique(c(L100_1$Identifier,L100_2$Identifier))

#
df_sub<-df[which(df$id %in% common_events),]

cols <- c("up" = Parent_col, "down" = L100_col, "ns" = "grey","diff"="black") 
sizes <- c("up" = 0.75, "down" = 0.75, "ns" = 0.25,"diff"=0.75) 
alphas <- c("up" = 0.7, "down" = 0.7, "ns" = 0.5,"diff"=0.7)

Up_genes<-as.character(length(which(df_sub$Group=="up")))
Down_genes<-as.character(length(which(df_sub$Group=="down")))

sig_genes<-df_sub[which(df_sub$id %in% c("chr19_45413962_45414034_45413433_45413745_45414860_45414960_-_ENSG00000012061_ERCC1",
                                 "chr14_23089981_23090101_23081747_23081836_23090521_23090633_-_ENSG00000100813_ACIN1")),]
sig_genes$name<-sapply(sig_genes$id,function(x){strsplit(x,"_")[[1]][10]})
sig_genes$color<-"orange"

volcano<-df_sub %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = difference,
             y = -log10(FDR),
             fill = Group,
             color=Group,
             size = Group,
             alpha =Group)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.2),
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.1,0.1),
             linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_color_manual(values = cols) + # Modify point colour
  scale_size_manual(values = sizes) + # Modify point size
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas) + # Modify point transparency
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-0.3,-0.15,0,0.15,0.3),       
                     limits = c(-0.35, 0.35))+
  lims(y=c(0,7.5))+
  labs(x=bquote(Delta~PSI(WT-Mut.PCBP1)))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_point(data=sig_genes,aes(x = difference,y = -log10(FDR)),color="black",fill=Parent_col,shape = 21) +
  geom_text_repel(data=sig_genes,aes(x=difference,y=-log10(FDR),label=name),color="black",size=2,fill=NA,label.size = NA,nudge_x = 0.2,nudge_y = 0.4,segment.color = "black",segment.size = 0.3,min.segment.length = 0)+
  geom_text(x=0.25, y=6, label=paste("Skipped \n",Up_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2)+
  geom_text(x=-0.25, y=6, label=paste("Retained \n",Down_genes,sep=""),color="black",size=2)+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text=element_text(size=6, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=6, color="black"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(), 
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank())
volcano
ggsave("~/Desktop/Dan/Volcano.pdf",volcano,width = 1.5,height = 1.5)
```

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
r_sec<-read.table("../Data and Code In Experimental Order/7_expanded_cancers/SEC_Burkit/For_gilbert.txt",header=T,sep="\t")

#Mean
r_sec$WT_Mean<-apply(r_sec[c("WT","WT.1")],1,mean,na.rm=T)
r_sec$G292D_Mean<-apply(r_sec[c("G292D","G292D.1")],1,mean,na.rm=T)
r_sec$I302M_Mean<-apply(r_sec[c("I302M","I302M.1")],1,mean,na.rm=T)
r_sec$Y183_Mean<-apply(r_sec[c("Y183.","Y183..1")],1,mean,na.rm=T)

r_sec$WT_Max<-apply(r_sec[c("WT","WT.1")],1,max,na.rm=T)
r_sec$G292D_Max<-apply(r_sec[c("G292D","G292D.1")],1,max,na.rm=T)
r_sec$I302M_Max<-apply(r_sec[c("I302M","I302M.1")],1,max,na.rm=T)
r_sec$Y183_Max<-apply(r_sec[c("Y183.","Y183..1")],1,max,na.rm=T)

r_sec$WT_Min<-apply(r_sec[c("WT","WT.1")],1,min,na.rm=T)
r_sec$G292D_Min<-apply(r_sec[c("G292D","G292D.1")],1,min,na.rm=T)
r_sec$I302M_Min<-apply(r_sec[c("I302M","I302M.1")],1,min,na.rm=T)
r_sec$Y183_Min<-apply(r_sec[c("Y183.","Y183..1")],1,min,na.rm=T)

wt<-r_sec[c("Fraction","WT_Mean","WT_Min","WT_Max")]
G292D<-r_sec[c("Fraction","G292D_Mean","G292D_Min","G292D_Max")]
I302M<-r_sec[c("Fraction","I302M_Mean","I302M_Min","I302M_Max")]
Y183<-r_sec[c("Fraction","Y183_Mean","Y183_Min","Y183_Max")]

colnames(wt)<-c("Fraction","Mean","Min","Max")
colnames(G292D)<-c("Fraction","Mean","Min","Max")
colnames(I302M)<-c("Fraction","Mean","Min","Max")
colnames(Y183)<-c("Fraction","Mean","Min","Max")

wt$Group<-"WT"
G292D$Group<-"G292D"
I302M$Group<-"I302M"
Y183$Group<-"Y183*"

df<-data.frame(rbind(wt,G292D,I302M,Y183))
df$Group<-factor(df$Group,levels=c("WT","G292D","I302M","Y183*"))
df$Fraction<-factor(df$Fraction)
df$Min[which(is.infinite(df$Min))]<-NA
df$Max[which(is.infinite(df$Max))]<-NA

Parent_col="#0096FE"
G292D_col="#294936"
I302M_col="#5941A9"
Y183_col="#FA7921"

ggplot()+
  geom_line(data=df,aes(x=Fraction,y=Mean,group = Group,color=Group),size=.25)+
  geom_point(data=df,aes(x=Fraction,y=Mean),color="black",size=0.3)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("WT"=Parent_col, "G292D"=G292D_col,"I302M"=I302M_col,"Y183*"=Y183_col))+
```

```{r,fig.width=1.5, fig.height=1.5}
rm(list=ls())
#Loading TCGA events
SE<-read.table("TCGA_PSI_SE.txt",header = T)
PE<-read.table("TCGA_PSI_PE.txt",header = T)

colnames(SE)<-gsub("[.]","-",colnames(SE))
colnames(PE)<-gsub("[.]","-",colnames(PE))

#removing samples that are in both 
SE<-SE[,which(!colnames(SE) %in% colnames(PE))]

#checking
SE_sub<-SE
PE_sub<-PE
common_identifiers<-intersect(rownames(SE_sub),rownames(PE_sub))
table(rownames(SE_sub) %in% rownames(PE_sub))
SE_sub<-SE_sub[common_identifiers,]
PE_sub<-PE_sub[common_identifiers,]
table(rownames(SE_sub) == rownames(PE_sub))
all_PSI<-cbind(SE_sub,PE_sub)

###plotting each event
mut<-read.delim("TCGA_mutation.txt",header=T)
mut$Sample<-sapply(mut$Sample.ID,function(x){y<-strsplit(x,"-")[[1]];return(paste(y[1:3],collapse="-"))})
mut<-mut[which(mut$Protein_APC==1),]
mut$Sample.ID<-sapply(mut$Sample.ID,function(x){paste(strsplit(x,"-")[[1]][1:3],collapse = "-")})
mut<-mut[which(mut$Sample.ID %in% colnames(all_PSI)),]
mut$Sample.ID<-sapply(mut$Sample.ID,function(x){paste(strsplit(x,"-")[[1]][1:3],collapse = "-")})
l100_samples<-mut$Sample.ID[which(mut$Protein.Change %in% c("L100P","L100Q","L102P","L102Q","L102R"))]
rest<-setdiff(mut$Sample.ID,l100_samples)

table(l100_samples %in% names(all_PSI))
table(rest %in% names(all_PSI))
table(rest %in% l100_samples)

#Getting the test and pval
p_val<-c()
difference<-c()
id<-c()
for (i in rownames(all_PSI)){
  l<-unlist(as.vector(all_PSI[i,l100_samples]))
  o<-unlist(as.vector(all_PSI[i,rest]))
  test<-ks.test(l,o)
  p_val<-c(p_val,test$p.value)
  difference<-c(difference,mean(o,na.rm=T)-mean(l,na.rm=T))
  id<-c(id,i)
}
df<-data.frame(id,difference,p_val)
write.table(df,"../Omics-data/TCGA_summary.txt",sep="\t",col.names =T,row.names = F,quote=F)

```
